entries.name: a.BudgetMaxDeferFrames
entries.help: Frames in a row the budget may defer one animator before it must evaluate

entries.name: a.BudgetMs
entries.help: Evaluation budget in ms per frame; the lowest-priority animators are deferred with their dt banked. 0 = no budget (UE AnimationBudgetAllocator)

entries.name: a.EvalDuringPhysics
entries.help: Evaluate the animators nothing reads before the physics step (no root motion consumed by movement, no morph channels) beside that step, when the scene overlaps it (p.OverlapDuringPhysics); foot IK raycasts run after the step against the stepped world. 0 = every animator evaluates ahead of the step

entries.name: a.LOD
entries.help: Animator update-rate LOD around the focus: -1=on while a focus is set, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: a.LODBoneMask
entries.help: Apply the skeleton's per-LOD required-bone sets (Skeleton::SetLodBonesToRemove); 0 animates every bone at every LOD

entries.name: a.LODFarInterval
entries.help: Frame interval beyond the far radius

entries.name: a.LODFarRadius
entries.help: Animators beyond this sample every a.LODFarInterval frames

entries.name: a.LODNearInterval
entries.help: Frame interval between the near and far radius

entries.name: a.LODNearRadius
entries.help: Full-rate radius; animators beyond it sample every a.LODNearInterval frames

entries.name: a.OffscreenInterval
entries.help: Frame interval for an animator the scene has not drawn inside the camera frustum for two updates; 0 = visibility does not throttle (UE VisibilityBasedAnimTickOption)

entries.name: ai.AutoBodyFound
entries.help: Raise a dormant BodyFound situation when a crowd member or perceivable entity dies

entries.name: ai.Crowd
entries.help: Crowd system: 0=off, 1=on (tier assignment, particle flow, bulk brains, spawners)

entries.name: ai.Crowd.Debug
entries.help: Log crowd tier counts and pass timings every 60 frames

entries.name: ai.Crowd.FleeDistance
entries.help: How far a broadcast reaction pushes members away from the epicenter

entries.name: ai.Crowd.FleeDuration
entries.help: Seconds a member stays panicked after a broadcast reaction

entries.name: ai.Crowd.FleeSpeedScale
entries.help: Walk-speed multiplier while a member is panicked

entries.name: ai.Crowd.MaxBulk
entries.help: Hard cap of bulk-tier crowd members (shared state machine + dtCrowd nav, no perception)

entries.name: ai.Crowd.MaxFull
entries.help: Hard cap of full-tier crowd members (real AI: perception + behavior tree + dtCrowd nav)

entries.name: ai.Crowd.SeparationRadius
entries.help: Particle-tier neighbor separation radius in meters

entries.name: ai.Crowd.SeparationWeight
entries.help: Particle-tier separation steering weight

entries.name: ai.Crowd.SpawnPerFrame
entries.help: Crowd members instantiated per spawner per frame (streaming-friendly ramp-up)

entries.name: ai.Crowd.TierDwell
entries.help: Seconds a member must stay in its tier before it can be promoted (hysteresis; demotions to respect caps are immediate)

entries.name: ai.Crowd.TierStickiness
entries.help: Score bonus incumbents get when ranked against challengers at a tier boundary; a challenger must beat an incumbent by this margin to swap tiers

entries.name: ai.FootstepNoise
entries.help: Footsteps report AI perception noise events, scaled louder when sprinting and quieter when crouching (0 = off)

entries.name: ai.NoiseMap
entries.help: Spread every sound and scan the AI hears over a decaying noise map the director reads; 0 = no map

entries.name: ai.NoiseMap.CellSize
entries.help: Edge of one noise map cell, in metres

entries.name: ai.NoiseMap.HalfLife
entries.help: Seconds for the noise map to fall to half

entries.name: ai.NoiseMap.Reach
entries.help: How far one unit of loudness spreads over the noise map before walls and doors take their share, in metres

entries.name: ai.PerceptionMaxRaysPerFrame
entries.help: Maximum sight line-of-sight raycasts per frame across all AI perceivers; nearest candidates win, the rest coast on their last visibility

entries.name: ai.ScanFlashReach
entries.help: How far a LiDAR scan's flash is seen by AI facing it with a clear line of sight, in metres; 0 = scans are invisible to AI

entries.name: ai.ScanPulseReach
entries.help: How far in metres a scan pulse carries to AI hearing before walls and portals take their share; 0 = scans are silent to AI

entries.name: ai.Schedule
entries.help: NPC schedule system: 0=off, 1=on (time-of-day acts, smart-point claiming, activity movement)

entries.name: ai.Schedule.ArriveRadius
entries.help: Distance in meters at which a scheduled agent counts as arrived at its activity point

entries.name: ai.Schedule.Debug
entries.help: Log schedule act changes and point claims

entries.name: ai.Schedule.HourOverride
entries.help: Forces the schedule hour to this value when >= 0 (debug/ToD scrubbing); -1 reads the scene's DayNight component

entries.name: ai.Schedule.LoopDwell
entries.help: Seconds a GoToAndLoop agent dwells at a point before re-picking another point of the same tag

entries.name: ai.Schedule.WanderRadius
entries.help: Wander-behavior disc radius for agents without a crowd home area

entries.name: ai.Significance
entries.help: AI significance manager: 0=off, 1=on; consumers fall back to their distance heuristics when off

entries.name: ai.SignificanceAudio
entries.help: Feed significance into audio voice priority (scales priority 0.5x-1x by score)

entries.name: ai.SignificanceBTLowInterval
entries.help: Minimum behavior-tree tick interval for low-significance agents

entries.name: ai.SignificanceBTMidInterval
entries.help: Minimum behavior-tree tick interval for mid-significance agents

entries.name: ai.SignificanceBudget
entries.help: Entities re-scored per frame, round-robin; the rest keep their last score

entries.name: ai.SignificanceHighThreshold
entries.help: Scores at or above this are high significance (full consumer rates)

entries.name: ai.SignificanceLowThreshold
entries.help: Scores below this are low significance (coarsest consumer rates)

entries.name: ai.SignificancePerceptionInterval
entries.help: Low-significance perceivers run AI perception every Nth frame

entries.name: ai.Situation
entries.help: Situation system: 0=off, 1=on (raise/decay, witness knowledge, propagation, trespass volumes)

entries.name: ai.Situation.BodyFoundRadius
entries.help: Reaction radius of an auto-raised BodyFound situation

entries.name: ai.Situation.ConversationRange
entries.help: Distance in meters within which two full AI agents can exchange situation knowledge

entries.name: ai.Situation.ConversationTime
entries.help: Seconds two agents must stay within earshot (conversation range scaled by the walls and portals between them) before situation knowledge propagates

entries.name: ai.Situation.Debug
entries.help: Log situation raises, discoveries, propagation and decay

entries.name: ai.Situation.DormantChecksPerFrame
entries.help: Dormant-situation sight tests per frame (BodyFound discovery), round-robin over perceivers

entries.name: ai.Situation.ExplosionLifetime
entries.help: Seconds before an Explosion situation decays

entries.name: ai.Situation.GunshotLifetime
entries.help: Seconds before a Gunshot situation decays

entries.name: ai.Situation.PropagationAgentsPerFrame
entries.help: Agents whose conversation pairs are checked per frame (round-robin stagger, never N^2)

entries.name: ai.Situation.Raise
entries.help: Debug raise consumed on the next situation tick: 'Type x y z radius severity' (e.g. 'Gunshot 0 0 0 25 1')

entries.name: ai.Situation.SuspiciousLifetime
entries.help: Seconds before a Suspicious (or Custom) situation decays

entries.name: ai.Situation.TrespassLifetime
entries.help: Seconds before a Trespass situation decays

entries.name: ai.Situation.VandalismLifetime
entries.help: Seconds before a Vandalism situation decays

entries.name: arc.DeferredPopupRelease
entries.help: Free a closed menu's popup window once the GPU has retired its frames instead of tearing its swapchain down on the spot, which waits for the whole device several times per close. 0 = the old immediate teardown (for measuring it). Read once at Arc startup.

entries.name: arc.Density
entries.help: UI density: 0 = Compact, 1 = Default, 2 = Comfortable (Preferences > Appearance > Density). Applies live: every measure is dropped and the UI re-lays out.

entries.name: arc.inputdiag
entries.help: Report Arc input routing state (root widget, mouse capture, focus, hover, hit test)

entries.name: arc.OSPopups
entries.help: Host menus and tooltips in their own topmost OS windows (overhang the owning window like native apps). 0 = legacy in-window overlays. Read once at Arc startup.

entries.name: arc.PopupsInWindow
entries.help: Paint a menu or tooltip that fits inside its owning window there, and give an OS window only to one that must overhang it. 0 = every menu and tooltip in its own OS window. Read once at Arc startup.

entries.name: arc.RetainedPaint
entries.help: Replay retained draw slices for opted-in widget subtrees on clean frames. 0 = paint every widget every frame, the ground truth a suspected stale-pixel bug is compared against.

entries.name: arc.Shaping
entries.help: HarfBuzz text shaping for Arc UI text (GPOS kerning, ligatures, mark placement). 0 = legacy FreeType kern-table path.

entries.name: arc.SkipUnchangedWindows
entries.help: Skip a window's layout, paint and buffer upload on frames where nothing in it changed (every window still records over its scene and presents). 2 = an owned window that samples nothing live also skips its record and present. 0 = paint every window every frame.

entries.name: arc.SkipUnchangedWindows.LogFrames
entries.help: Every this many frames, log the main window's average produce time (layout, paint, snapshot) and how many window paints and presents the skip saved over them. 0 = off.

entries.name: arc.SkipUnchangedWindows.VerifyFrames
entries.help: A window that skips its paint paints anyway after this many skipped frames and compares the result with the frame it was replaying; a difference makes it paint every frame for a while.

entries.name: arc.TextContrast
entries.help: Contrast added to text coverage before the gamma blend (0 to 1), strongest for dark text.

entries.name: arc.TextFloatingContrast
entries.help: arc.TextContrast for text inside a floating surface (0 to 1).

entries.name: arc.TextFloatingGamma
entries.help: arc.TextGamma for text inside a floating surface (a popover, a confirm), which the design's browser draws on its own layer with less of the lift.

entries.name: arc.TextGamma
entries.help: Gamma text coverage is blended in, as a browser blends it (1 = the target's sRGB-encoded space, up to 3). Light text on a dark ground gains weight, dark text on a light ground loses some.

entries.name: arc.TextStemDarkening
entries.help: Stem darkening of the design faces below 14 device px, as a fraction of the em. Read once when the fonts load.

entries.name: arc.ThemeRemap
entries.help: After a live theme switch, repaint colours that widgets copied from the previous theme's tokens in the new theme's values. 0 = only widgets built after the switch take the new theme.

entries.name: arc.UIScale
entries.help: Override the DPI-derived UI scale (1.0 = 96 DPI, 2.0 = 192 DPI). Negative keeps the auto-detected value. Read once at Arc startup.

entries.name: asset.MemoryBudgetMB
entries.help: Resident asset budget in MB the LRU eviction keeps under; 0 = the manager's own (4 GB). The runtime and the editor claim it from the device's VRAM at startup unless config or the command line set it

entries.name: asset.UploadMBPerFrame
entries.help: Max megabytes of whole-asset GPU uploads (CreateGPU) an AssetManager drains per frame, on top of asset.UploadsPerFrame; the first upload of a frame always lands; <= 0 = unbounded

entries.name: asset.UploadsPerFrame
entries.help: Max GPU asset uploads (CreateGPU) an AssetManager drains per frame; <= 0 = unbounded

entries.name: au.Debug
entries.help: Print the mixer's state: voice counts, submix meters, concurrency groups, memory budget, parameters

entries.name: au.Debug.Attenuation
entries.help: Draw every playing spatial voice's min and max distance in the viewport (Audio debug-draw category)

entries.name: audio.Acoustics
entries.help: Geometric acoustics: occlusion through the scan hierarchy, reverb and early reflections traced from the level, echolocation; 0 = the physics material trace and the scanner's echo tail only

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.EchoClip
entries.help: Clip each returning echo plays from where it bounced; empty = echoes are computed but not voiced

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.EchoConeDegrees
entries.help: Full cone angle of an echolocation click, in degrees

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.EchoNoise
entries.help: Loudness the AI hears an echolocation click at; 0 = clicks are silent to AI

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.EchoRange
entries.help: How far an echolocation click reaches, in metres

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.EchoRays
entries.help: Rays one echolocation click sends out

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.Geometry
entries.help: What sound is traced against: 0 = the scan hierarchy when its plugin is loaded, else physics; 1 = scan hierarchy only; 2 = physics only

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.MaxDistance
entries.help: Longest leg any acoustic ray follows, in metres

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.MaxReflections
entries.help: Early reflections kept per update, earliest first

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.ReflectionOrder
entries.help: Highest early-reflection order (surfaces per path, 1-3)

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.ReverbBounces
entries.help: Bounces each reverb ray follows before it is retired

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.ReverbRays
entries.help: Rays traced from the listener to measure the room's decay

entries.name: audio.Acoustics.UpdateHz
entries.help: How often per second the listener's reverb and early reflections are re-traced

entries.name: audio.AutoSubtitles
entries.help: Subtitle speech nobody captioned — proximity voice and audio games push in — with the on-device speech recognizer; nothing leaves the machine

entries.name: audio.AutoSubtitles.Available
entries.help: Project option read by mbt package: ship the speech recognizer (ONNX Runtime, this module, the 95 MB model) so players can turn auto-subtitles on

entries.name: audio.AutoSubtitles.MinConfidence
entries.help: Lines the recognizer is less sure of than this are not shown, 0..1

entries.name: audio.AutoSubtitles.PauseSeconds
entries.help: A pause this long ends a line

entries.name: audio.AutoSubtitles.Voice
entries.help: Auto-subtitle what other players say over proximity voice and radio

entries.name: audio.ClosedCaptions
entries.help: Also show non-speech sound descriptions such as [door creaks]

entries.name: audio.DopplerMaxSpeed
entries.help: Transform-derived speeds above this (m/s) are treated as teleports and contribute no doppler

entries.name: audio.DopplerScale
entries.help: Global doppler intensity multiplier applied on top of each source's dopplerScale; 0 disables doppler entirely

entries.name: audio.EchoTailSubmix
entries.help: Submix that carries the convolution reverb built from scan hits (FEchoTail); empty = no echo reverb

entries.name: audio.OcclusionRaycastBudget
entries.help: Maximum source-to-listener occlusion raycasts per frame; nearest sources win

entries.name: audio.Spatializer
entries.help: Spatializer for 3D voices: Native (miniaudio), Panner (equal-power reference), or a plugin's registered name

entries.name: audio.SubtitleBackgroundOpacity
entries.help: Opacity of the plate drawn behind subtitle text, 0 to 1

entries.name: audio.SubtitleMaxLines
entries.help: Maximum subtitle lines shown at once

entries.name: audio.Subtitles
entries.help: Show subtitles for spoken dialogue and captioned voice cues

entries.name: audio.SubtitleScale
entries.help: Subtitle text size multiplier

entries.name: audio.SubtitleSpeakerNames
entries.help: Prefix each subtitle line with the speaker's name

entries.name: cam.FOV
entries.help: Accessibility: the player's vertical field of view in degrees for the gameplay camera, 0 = each camera's authored value; a sequencer cut camera always keeps its own

entries.name: cam.ShakeScale
entries.help: Accessibility: multiplier on every camera shake, trauma-driven and modifier-driven alike, 0 = still camera, 1 = as authored

entries.name: carry.BreakDistance
entries.help: Constraint stretch (m) between hold point and carried object beyond which the carry breaks and the object drops

entries.name: carry.MotorDamping
entries.help: Spring damping of the carry hold motor

entries.name: carry.MotorFrequency
entries.help: Spring frequency (Hz) of the carry hold motor that drags a carried object toward the hold point

entries.name: carry.MotorMaxForce
entries.help: Per-axis force limit (N) of the carry hold motor; heavy objects lag behind the hold point instead of snapping

entries.name: carry.PerCarrierMaxForce
entries.help: Hold-motor force limit (N) of ONE carrier on a Heavy object. About what a person can lift one-handed-and-a-half: one carrier drags an 80 kg crate, two lift it.

entries.name: carry.PlaceSnapMaxAngleDeg
entries.help: Maximum surface slope (degrees from up) a place-snap drop aligns to; steeper surfaces leave the dropped pose untouched

entries.name: carry.PlaceSnapRayDist
entries.help: Downward raycast distance (m) used by place-snap to find the surface under a dropped object

entries.name: dd.Audio
entries.help: Debug-draw layer: audio source ranges

entries.name: dd.Bounds
entries.help: Debug-draw layer: selected-entity world-space AABBs

entries.name: dd.Cover
entries.help: Debug-draw layer: AI cover points (markers, protection arcs, occupancy)

entries.name: dd.Director
entries.help: Debug-draw layer: AI director (spawn rings around players, tracked threat markers, pacing overlay line)

entries.name: dd.Navigation
entries.help: Debug-draw layer: navigation mesh overlay

entries.name: dd.Perception
entries.help: Debug-draw layer: AI perception (sight cones, LOS rays, hearing radii, last-known-position markers)

entries.name: ddc.AudioCook
entries.help: Cache decoded audio as .maudio blobs in the DDC: -1=code default (ON), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: ddc.MaxSizeMB
entries.help: Size cap on the project's derived data cache in MB; least recently used entries are evicted past it. 0 = uncapped

entries.name: ddc.MeshCook
entries.help: Keep models built from source in the DDC, so a warm load skips the translation and the build: -1=code default (ON), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: ddc.TextureCook
entries.help: Cache stb-decoded sources as cooked .mtex mip chains in the DDC so the editor shows the cooked texture: -1=code default (on), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: editor.AsyncImportGpuWorkPerFrame
entries.help: Max GPU work units (submesh meshes / materials) built per frame while draining async model imports; <= 0 = unbounded

entries.name: editor.AsyncImportThreads
entries.help: Editor async import loader threads; 0 = a quarter of the cores, between 2 and 4

entries.name: editor.AutosaveIntervalSeconds
entries.help: How often (seconds) the editor writes a crash-recovery autosave of the active dirty scene into Saved/Autosaves. 0 disables autosave.

entries.name: editor.ContentWatchDebounceMs
entries.help: Quiet time after the last content-tree change before the registry reconciles; <= 0 disables the watcher

entries.name: editor.ContentWatchMinIntervalMs
entries.help: Shortest gap between two watcher-triggered registry reconciles

entries.name: editor.DeferPaintUploads
entries.help: While the UI paints ahead of the render thread, queue the texture uploads the paint asks for (glyph atlas bands, lazily created images) and run them on the render thread before it records the UI. 0 = upload from the paint, which lost the D3D12 device in most Release runs.

entries.name: editor.Details.LogRefresh
entries.help: Log each Details refresh: rows handed to the list, rows rebuilt, the row model's build time, and the time the list spent building row widgets.

entries.name: editor.Details.PartialRefresh
entries.help: A property edit rebuilds only the Details rows whose content changed. 0 = every refresh rebuilds every row.

entries.name: editor.IdleSceneSettleFrames
entries.help: Idle frames the viewports keep rendering after the last change before they hold their image, so TAA, GI and exposure converge first (72 = 3 s at the 24 Hz idle cap).

entries.name: editor.IdleSkipSceneRender
entries.help: While the editor sits idle (the idle frame cap applies) and no camera, pane, entity or selection changed, stop rendering the level viewports once the temporal passes settled; the last image stays up. 0 = render every frame, idle or not.

entries.name: editor.ImportAsPackages
entries.help: 1 = a texture imports into a Texture package (.tex) and a sound into a Sound package (.sound) built from the source where it lies; 0 = the legacy copy into Content/ with a .mdfmeta sidecar. A texture asking for AI enhancement always takes the legacy path

entries.name: editor.ImportModelsAsPackages
entries.help: 1 = a model imports into SkeletalMesh/StaticMesh, Skeleton, AnimSequence and Texture packages built from the source where it lies; 0 = the legacy copy into Content/ with a .mdfmeta sidecar

entries.name: editor.mcp.enabled
entries.help: Serve the editor's tools over MCP on a loopback HTTP port (Editor Preferences > MCP Server).

entries.name: editor.mcp.port
entries.help: Loopback port of the editor's MCP server; 0 takes any free port.

entries.name: editor.MessageLog.OpenOnNewError
entries.help: Bring the Message Log to the front when a new error arrives. 0 leaves the panel where it is and raises a toast instead.

entries.name: editor.OverlapStartupLoads
entries.help: Read and parse the start scene and index the Visual Script classes on their own threads while the project's asset registry loads or rebuilds. 0 = one after another on the editor thread, for comparing startup times

entries.name: editor.SyncImport
entries.help: Editor model import: 0 = async (CPU on loader thread, GPU drained on the main thread), 1 = synchronous (blocking, legacy)

entries.name: editor.Thumbnails.AsyncReadback
entries.help: Read a rendered thumbnail back for the disk cache a few frames after its blit, polling a fence, instead of a synchronous readback that drains the GPU queue inside the editor frame: 1=on, 0=synchronous (A/B)

entries.name: editor.UIPaintAhead
entries.help: Paint the editor UI for frame N+1 while the render thread still records frame N (double-buffered Arc batch); the uploads the paint asks for run on the record side (editor.DeferPaintUploads). 0 = paint only after the render thread drained.

entries.name: editor.Viewport.RenderResolution
entries.help: Render the level viewport at a fixed WxH (e.g. 1920x1080) and stretch it into the panel; empty = the panel's own size

entries.name: eqs.ItemBudget
entries.help: Environment-query item measurements EnvQuerySystem spends per frame across every queued query; a query that runs out resumes next frame where it stopped. <= 0 finishes the whole queue in one frame

entries.name: fx.Particles.Parallel
entries.help: Simulate CPU emitter trees and build their billboards on worker threads, one task per emitter: 0 = all on the calling thread

entries.name: game.Rewind
entries.help: Time rewind: keep the last seconds of play and let gameplay (the Visual Script Rewind node) return to any of them

entries.name: game.Rewind.BudgetMB
entries.help: Memory time rewind may hold; past it the oldest moments go first

entries.name: game.Rewind.CaptureHz
entries.help: Moments time rewind captures per second; a rewind lands on one of them

entries.name: game.Rewind.Seconds
entries.help: How far back time rewind can go

entries.name: i.CursorConfine
entries.help: Override how the cursor is confined to the window: -1 = whatever game code asked for, 0 = never, 1 = only while the game holds the cursor lock, 2 = always while focused. The lock takes the cursor into relative mode and confines it as a side effect, so only a game with a VISIBLE cursor needs 2 — without it that cursor walks onto the second monitor and the next click lands in another application. Focus gates every mode

entries.name: i.DebugOverlay
entries.help: Draw the per-action input debug overlay (context, action, phase, value, trigger events, suppression) in the viewport

entries.name: i.Gamepad0.StickDeadzone
entries.help: Stick deadzone for slot 0; -1 = use i.StickDeadzone

entries.name: i.Gamepad0.TriggerDeadzone
entries.help: Trigger deadzone for slot 0; -1 = use i.TriggerDeadzone

entries.name: i.Gamepad1.StickDeadzone
entries.help: Stick deadzone for slot 1; -1 = use i.StickDeadzone

entries.name: i.Gamepad1.TriggerDeadzone
entries.help: Trigger deadzone for slot 1; -1 = use i.TriggerDeadzone

entries.name: i.Gamepad2.StickDeadzone
entries.help: Stick deadzone for slot 2; -1 = use i.StickDeadzone

entries.name: i.Gamepad2.TriggerDeadzone
entries.help: Trigger deadzone for slot 2; -1 = use i.TriggerDeadzone

entries.name: i.Gamepad3.StickDeadzone
entries.help: Stick deadzone for slot 3; -1 = use i.StickDeadzone

entries.name: i.Gamepad3.TriggerDeadzone
entries.help: Trigger deadzone for slot 3; -1 = use i.TriggerDeadzone

entries.name: i.HoldToToggle
entries.help: Accessibility: a Hold trigger marked allow_toggle latches on its first press and releases on the next, instead of needing the key held down

entries.name: i.MouseInvertY
entries.help: Invert the mouse Y delta axis

entries.name: i.MouseSensitivity
entries.help: Multiplier applied to both mouse-delta axes before any binding modifier (0.05..10)

entries.name: i.RumbleScale
entries.help: Accessibility: multiplier on every gamepad rumble and trigger-haptic request, 0 = off, 1 = as authored

entries.name: i.StickDeadzone
entries.help: Stick deadzone applied to every gamepad slot (0..1); the live range remaps to the full -1..1

entries.name: i.TriggerDeadzone
entries.help: Analog trigger deadzone applied to every gamepad slot (0..1); the live range remaps to the full 0..1

entries.name: i18n.Locale
entries.help: Active UI locale — tables load from <root>/<locale>/*.txt on change

entries.name: i18n.PseudoLocalize
entries.help: Pseudo-localize every localized string (accented, a third longer, bracketed) to find text that was never localized and labels that will not fit a longer language

entries.name: import.AutoCutoutAlpha
entries.help: Classify a material as alpha-masked when its base-colour alpha reads as authored cut-out coverage, for sources that declare no alphaMode and ship no opacity slot (ORCA/Falcor, DCC FBX foliage): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: import.ForceUpAxis
entries.help: Rotate a source up-axis into engine +Y at import: -1=auto/off, 0=source X-up, 1=Y-up (no-op), 2=Z-up

entries.name: import.UniformScale
entries.help: Extra uniform scale baked into every imported model's node transform: <=0 = off (use per-import), >0 = force this factor

entries.name: interact.ConeDeg
entries.help: Half-angle (degrees) of the view cone interactables must fall inside to be focusable

entries.name: interact.Range
entries.help: Default interaction reach (m) used when an Interactable leaves its own range at zero

entries.name: interact.ScreenCenterWeight
entries.help: Focus scoring weight of the angle to screen center relative to plain distance; higher favors what the camera looks at over what is merely close

entries.name: lidar.CatchupShotsPerTick
entries.help: Shots of history the host sends a late joiner per tick.

entries.name: lidar.HistoryMaxShots
entries.help: Shots the host keeps to replay to a late joiner; the oldest go first. 0 = unbounded.

entries.name: lidar.MaxOriginDistance
entries.help: How far (metres) a shot's origin may be from the shooter's pawn on the host. 0 = unchecked.

entries.name: lidar.MaxRaysPerSecond
entries.help: Host token bucket of LiDAR rays per player per second — what every peer pays to re-trace. 0 = unlimited.

entries.name: lidar.MaxRaysPerShot
entries.help: Host cap on one replicated LiDAR shot's ray count; a larger shot is refused and not relayed.

entries.name: lidar.MaxShotRange
entries.help: Host cap on a replicated LiDAR shot's range (metres).

entries.name: lidar.MaxShotsPerSecond
entries.help: Host token bucket of LiDAR shots per player per second. 0 = unlimited.

entries.name: LiveCoding
entries.help: LiveCoding — recompile the .cpp files changed since this process started and patch them in (Ctrl+Alt+F11)

entries.name: liveops.ConfigUrl
entries.help: Where the game fetches its signed remote config at start; empty = defaults and the cache only

entries.name: liveops.TelemetryBatch
entries.help: Telemetry events sent per upload

entries.name: liveops.TelemetryJournal
entries.help: Keep opted-in telemetry in Saved/Telemetry/events.jsonl as well, the file `mbt liveops report` reads

entries.name: liveops.TimeoutSeconds
entries.help: How long a remote-config fetch or a telemetry upload may take

entries.name: log
entries.help: log | log <category> <trace|debug|info|warning|error|fatal|reset>

entries.name: mdf.Validate
entries.help: MDF document validation on load. -1 = app default (editors on, runtime off), 0 = force off, 1 = force on.

entries.name: meaf.Verify
entries.help: MEAF payload verification: -1 = auto (2 when signed, else 1), 0 = off, 1 = per-entry CRC32 on load, 2 = also hash the data section at mount

entries.name: ml.ExecutionProvider
entries.help: Where on-device inference (AI texture enhancement, auto-subtitles) runs: auto takes the GPU through the WebGPU execution provider for texture enhancement and keeps the speech recognizer on the CPU (on the GPU it measured no faster and would share the game's frame), gpu puts every model on the GPU and warns when it has to fall back, cpu never touches the GPU. Applies to models loaded from then on

entries.name: mods.Enabled
entries.help: Load mods from <package>/Mods, Saved/Mods and the providers (Steam Workshop) at start

entries.name: mods.EnableNew
entries.help: A mod the enable list has never seen starts enabled; off, the player turns each new mod on

entries.name: mods.RequireSigned
entries.help: Refuse a mod whose pak is not signed

entries.name: mods.TrustedKeys
entries.help: Comma-separated hex public keys trusted to sign any mod

entries.name: mods.TrustedOnly
entries.help: Accept only mods signed by mods.TrustedKeys or the game's own key, not by their author's

entries.name: mowo.GC.Incremental
entries.help: Spread the periodic GC across frames: the mark runs in mowo.GC.StepBudgetMs slices behind the TObjectPtr write barrier, then the sweep deletes at most mowo.GC.SweepBudget objects per frame. 0 = the old synchronous pass that marks AND deletes everything in one frame.

entries.name: mowo.GC.IntervalSeconds
entries.help: How often (seconds) the GC fires. Set to 0 to disable periodic GC; manual `Force Garbage Collect` from the editor still works.

entries.name: mowo.GC.StepBudgetMs
entries.help: Per-frame marking budget (milliseconds) for the incremental GC. <= 0 = the mark completes atomically in one step (the old stop-the-world hitch). Budgeted marking became the DEFAULT once every engine MPROPERTY object ref went barriered (R5.1): TObjectPtr<T> fields barrier every store, the three raw-pointer MPROPERTY containers (world actors, actor components, attach children) shade their stores at the insertion sites, and SetOuter / actor spawn/attach call NotifyReferenceWrite. A game-module class that adds a plain T* MPROPERTY re-opens the hole — use TObjectPtr.

entries.name: mowo.GC.SweepBudget
entries.help: Max objects deleted per frame during the incremental GC sweep. <= 0 = unbounded (sweep completes in one step).

entries.name: mowo.Profiler.Capture
entries.help: Retain the last N profiler frames (CPU scopes, GPU passes, memory tags) so they can be scrubbed and exported. Off by default - the ring copies every scope sample each frame.

entries.name: mowo.Trace.File
entries.help: Stream every profiled frame to this .mtrace file (open it in MowoInsights). Empty stops the trace. --trace=<file> sets it at startup.

entries.name: mowo.Trace.MaxSizeMB
entries.help: Size of one .mtrace part in MB; past it the trace continues in <name>_001.mtrace, <name>_002.mtrace, ... 0 = one unbounded file.

entries.name: nav.ParallelTileBake
entries.help: Bake the tiles of a tiled nav mesh on the job pool (1) or one after another (0); the result is the same either way

entries.name: nav.PathQueryBudget
entries.help: Detour search iterations NavAgentSystem spends per frame on queued gameplay path requests (RequestPathAsync); a request that runs out resumes next frame. <= 0 finishes the whole queue in one frame

entries.name: nav.Rebuild
entries.help: Rebuild tiled navmeshes at runtime where nav-relevant geometry moved, appeared or disappeared; 0 = the baked mesh stays as baked

entries.name: nav.Rebuild.MaxDelay
entries.help: Seconds after which dirty navmesh areas rebuild even while geometry keeps moving

entries.name: nav.Rebuild.MaxTiles
entries.help: Most navmesh tiles one runtime rebuild pass bakes; further dirty areas wait for the next pass

entries.name: nav.Rebuild.SettleTime
entries.help: Seconds the dirty navmesh areas must stay unchanged before their tiles rebuild, so a door swinging shut rebuilds once

entries.name: nav.StreamBySector
entries.help: Keep only the navmesh tiles whose world-streaming sector is loaded in the live mesh: a tile leaves with its sector and comes back with it. Tiled, obstacle-free meshes only; a world with no streaming sectors keeps every tile

entries.name: nav.StreamTilesPerFrame
entries.help: Navmesh tiles NavAgentSystem adds or removes per lane per frame while streaming by sector. <= 0 = no limit

entries.name: nav.UseCrowd
entries.help: Steer agents through dtCrowd when it is up. 0 = single-agent path following on the budgeted path queue (the fallback a failed crowd init takes)

entries.name: net.ack_probe_interval
entries.help: Snapshot ticks between keep-alive probes sent to an ack-stalled peer. The probe is an empty header, so its cost does not scale with object count.

entries.name: net.BlobBytesPerSecond
entries.help: Bytes per second the blob lane sends to one peer. 0 = unlimited (the window still bounds what is in flight).

entries.name: net.BlobWindowChunks
entries.help: Blob chunks (1 KiB each) a sender may have unacknowledged per peer before it waits for the receiver.

entries.name: net.CharacterPrediction
entries.help: Client-side character prediction with server reconcile through the real Jolt character step. 0 = interpolation-only ghosts, no input receiver.

entries.name: net.CorrectionSmoothTime
entries.help: Time constant (seconds) of the visual offset that hides a prediction correction on the local pawn. 0 = snap.

entries.name: net.CorrectionSnapDistance
entries.help: A correction larger than this (meters) is a teleport and snaps instead of smoothing.

entries.name: net.cull_distance
entries.help: Default distance-relevancy radius (world units) for NetworkObjects that don't set net_cull_distance.

entries.name: net.encrypt
entries.help: ENet session encryption: on (every link, LAN included) | auto (non-private addresses only) | off

entries.name: net.input_rate_limit
entries.help: Max client->server Input packets accepted per peer per second. 0 = unlimited.

entries.name: net.MaxBlobBytes
entries.help: Largest RPC (bytes) the blob lane sends, and the largest a client accepts from the host.

entries.name: net.MaxClientBlobBytes
entries.help: Largest blob (bytes) a host reassembles from one client; a client that announces more is refused before any memory is reserved.

entries.name: net.MaxMoveDeltaTime
entries.help: Longest time (seconds) the server steps for one client move; a longer claimed delta is clamped, as UE's MaxMoveDeltaTime.

entries.name: net.MaxQueuedMoves
entries.help: Moves the server holds per player before it drops the oldest.

entries.name: net.max_snapshot_bytes
entries.help: Max snapshot packet bytes per client per tick. 0 = unlimited.

entries.name: net.max_unacked_sends
entries.help: Snapshot packets a peer may go without acking before the server stops sweeping objects for it and falls back to a keep-alive probe. 0 = never stall (unbounded resend).

entries.name: net.max_updates_per_tick
entries.help: Max snapshot entries per client per tick. 0 = unlimited. Overflow is deferred, not dropped — staleness raises priority.

entries.name: net.MoveCombineSeconds
entries.help: Longest time (seconds) one combined move may cover before it is sent; capped by net.MaxMoveDeltaTime. UE's ClientNetSendMoveDeltaTime.

entries.name: net.MoveCombining
entries.help: Hold a client move back and merge the next one into it when both carry the same input, no jump press and no root motion, as UE's pending-move combining. Halves the moves sent while input is steady.

entries.name: net.MoveTimeBudget
entries.help: How far (seconds) a client's moves may run ahead of the server's clock before the server makes them wait. Bounds speed hacks that claim more time than passed; UE's movement time discrepancy.

entries.name: net.OwnerPriorityBoost
entries.help: Priority multiplier for an object the peer owns (its pawn, its carried prop) within the object's tier. UE's sphere-with-owner-boost prioritizer. 1 = no boost.

entries.name: net.peer_byte_budget
entries.help: Outgoing bytes per second the server will spend on one peer. Reliable traffic is charged but never dropped; the unreliable snapshot sweep is capped by what remains. 6000 B/s = 48 kbit/s, the per-client target. 0 = unlimited.

entries.name: net.peer_in_byte_budget
entries.help: Incoming bytes per second the server will accept from one peer, charged before the packet is decoded. The RPC and input limits count packets, not bytes, so without this one peer can hand the host megabytes a second inside a legal packet rate. 0 = unlimited.

entries.name: net.PredictionSendHz
entries.help: Client input command send rate. Frames between sends accumulate into the command's dt so replay integrates the same time span.

entries.name: net.PredictionTolerance
entries.help: Positional divergence (meters) between the predicted pawn and the server's authoritative pose that triggers a rewind + replay correction.

entries.name: net.psk
entries.help: Pre-shared key mixed into the ENet handshake KDF; a peer without it fails key confirmation. Empty = the host makes up a join key per session, which every peer from off this machine must present (host:port#KEY)

entries.name: net.QuantizeMoves
entries.help: Snap a move's input axes to the grid the server simulates with (1/127 for movement, 1/100 for look) on both ends, so the client predicts with the exact values the server steps, as UE's acceleration quantization.

entries.name: net.rejoin_grace_seconds
entries.help: Seconds the host holds a dropped player's slot, pawn and NetworkIds so the same identity can re-bind to them. 0 = a disconnect is a leave.

entries.name: net.relevancy
entries.help: Per-client relevancy filtering, priority and the per-peer byte budget on the server. 0 = every peer sees every replicated object (legacy), still capped per packet by net.max_snapshot_bytes and the byte budget.

entries.name: net.rewind.frames
entries.help: Frames the net rewind ring keeps per peer (1800 = a minute at 30 Hz).

entries.name: net.rewind.record
entries.help: Keep a ring of every replicated frame on this peer and write it to Saved/NetRecordings when the session ends, for the Net Rewind panel.

entries.name: net.Rollback
entries.help: Rollback netcode for the play session: the ECS world runs as a deterministic fixed-step simulation, inputs are exchanged and predicted, mispredictions are rolled back and resimulated

entries.name: net.Rollback.ChecksumInterval
entries.help: Frames between desync checks (checksums of fully confirmed frames)

entries.name: net.Rollback.InputDelay
entries.help: Frames a local input waits before it is simulated; each one is a frame of latency the remote input can hide in

entries.name: net.Rollback.MaxPrediction
entries.help: Frames the simulation may run ahead of a peer's last input before it stalls

entries.name: net.Rollback.OnDesync
entries.help: What a desync does: 0 logs it and plays on, 1 logs it and ends the rollback session (net.Rollback off) so the machines stop simulating different worlds

entries.name: net.Rollback.TickRate
entries.help: Rollback simulation frames per second

entries.name: net.RpcBlobThreshold
entries.help: An RPC packet larger than this (bytes) goes through the blob lane: chunked on the reliable unordered channel under net.BlobBytesPerSecond and net.BlobWindowChunks, so it neither stalls the ordered reliable channel nor floods the link, but it is no longer ordered against the rest of the reliable stream. Arguments of 64 KiB or more, which the Rpc body cannot carry, always take it. 0 = only those.

entries.name: net.rpc_rate_limit
entries.help: Max client->server RPCs accepted per peer per second. 0 = unlimited (ENet applies no bandwidth limit of its own).

entries.name: net.rpc_rate_limit_high
entries.help: Max client->server RPCs per peer per second on methods registered as the HighRate channel class (a continuously-swept sensor, a held-trigger weapon). Separate bucket from net.rpc_rate_limit. 0 = unlimited.

entries.name: net.ServerForceMoveSeconds
entries.help: A remote pawn that sends no move for this long is stepped by the server with no input, so it still falls and gets pushed. 0 = never.

entries.name: net.ShipExposeEnetHost
entries.help: Release and profile listen server: 1 = also open the raw ENet UDP listener beside the Steam relay (direct --connect ip:port works, the host's IP is visible to every peer); 0 = relay only when Steam is up. Development builds always dual-listen.

entries.name: net.sim.dup
entries.help: Simulated duplication, percent of frames delivered twice. 0 = off.

entries.name: net.sim.jitter
entries.help: Simulated jitter in milliseconds, uniform noise on top of net.sim.latency. 0 = off.

entries.name: net.sim.latency
entries.help: Simulated one-way latency in milliseconds, added to every frame on send and on receive. 0 = off.

entries.name: net.sim.loss
entries.help: Simulated packet loss, percent of frames dropped on send and on receive. 0 = off.

entries.name: net.sim.reorder
entries.help: Simulated reordering, percent of frames held back so a later frame overtakes them. 0 = off.

entries.name: net.starvation_ticks
entries.help: A relevant object this many snapshot ticks stale outranks priority entirely. 0 = pure priority ordering (can starve).

entries.name: net.ViewConeDegrees
entries.help: Half-angle (degrees) of the view cone net.ViewConePriorityBoost applies inside.

entries.name: net.ViewConePriorityBoost
entries.help: Priority multiplier for an object inside the peer's view cone, fading to 1 at the cone's edge. UE's field-of-view prioritizer. 1 = off.

entries.name: net.voice_budget_share
entries.help: Largest share (0..1) of net.peer_byte_budget that voice relayed to a peer may spend; replication keeps the remainder. 0 = voice is not charged.

entries.name: p.AsyncTick
entries.help: Step Jolt on a worker between this frame's submit and the next frame's join; poses land one frame late and any call that reaches Jolt in between waits for the step

entries.name: p.Debug
entries.help: Master switch for the physics debug visualizer

entries.name: p.DebugAABB
entries.help: Draw world-space bounding boxes when p.Debug is on

entries.name: p.DebugCOM
entries.help: Draw centre-of-mass crosses when p.Debug is on

entries.name: p.DebugConstraints
entries.help: Draw constraint anchors when p.Debug is on

entries.name: p.DebugContacts
entries.help: Draw contact normals when p.Debug is on

entries.name: p.DebugShapes
entries.help: Draw collider wireframes when p.Debug is on

entries.name: p.DebugVelocity
entries.help: Draw velocity arrows when p.Debug is on

entries.name: p.Deterministic
entries.help: Reproducible physics: Jolt's jobs run single-threaded in a fixed order and contact events are dispatched sorted by body pair, so the same inputs replay bit-identically on the same binary and CPU

entries.name: p.LOD
entries.help: Distance simulation LOD around the focus: -1=on while a focus is set, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: p.LODSleepRadius
entries.help: Dynamic bodies farther than this from the focus are force-deactivated

entries.name: p.LODWakeRadius
entries.help: LOD-frozen bodies wake when the focus comes back within this radius

entries.name: p.MaxSubsteps
entries.help: Upper bound on fixed-timestep substeps per frame; time beyond this is discarded rather than banked

entries.name: p.OverlapDuringPhysics
entries.help: Kick the frame's physics steps onto a worker after the PrePhysics tick group and join after DuringPhysics, so those actor ticks overlap the solver; the world systems ordered ahead of physics still run before the kick, and what a DuringPhysics tick moves is seen by the next step, as in UE

entries.name: p.Stats
entries.help: Log the physics stats snapshot every N frames (0=off)

entries.name: p.Threads
entries.help: Upper bound on the workers Jolt splits a step across (-1 = the whole engine pool); ignored under p.Deterministic

entries.name: pcg.NodeCache
entries.help: Reuse a PCG node's points when its inputs, parameters, seed, bounds, landscape and splines hash to a result already computed, so a regeneration only reruns the nodes downstream of what changed. 0 = recompute every node

entries.name: pcg.NodeCacheEntries
entries.help: Node results the PCG cache keeps across every volume before it drops the least recently used

entries.name: phys.Debris.MaxCount
entries.help: Destruction debris budget per scene: the oldest shard is recycled when a break would exceed it.

entries.name: phys.Debris.MaxLifetime
entries.help: Seconds a destruction shard may exist before it is recycled, whatever its component asks for (0 on the component means this cap).

entries.name: phys.Debris.MaxSpawnPerFrame
entries.help: Destruction shards one frame may spawn across every break; a break past it produces fewer pieces instead of a hitch.

entries.name: r.AO.Divisor
entries.help: Resolution divisor for the AO trace and its horizontal blur; the vertical blur stays full-res and doubles as the bilateral upsample: -1=tier value, 1=full res, 2=half

entries.name: r.AsyncCompute.AvoidAluOverlap
entries.help: Join an async-compute lane before the first ALU-heavy pass (GTAO, RT sun shadow, MegaLights) instead of at its first consumer: 1 = join early (the lane only overlaps raster-bound work), 0 = overlap until the consumer

entries.name: r.Atmosphere.SunTransmittance
entries.help: Modulate the directional light by the atmospheric transmittance along the sun ray (reddens + dims the sun toward the horizon; the authored light color stays the artist's base): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.AutoExposure.EV
entries.help: EV compensation added on top of the scene's auto-exposure EV (photographic stops); 0 keeps scene authority

entries.name: r.AutoExposure.HighPercent
entries.help: Percentile metering (mode 3): where the metered window closes, in percent of the pixels ordered by luminance. -1 = the scene's own value

entries.name: r.AutoExposure.LowPercent
entries.help: Percentile metering (mode 3): where the metered window opens, in percent of the pixels ordered by luminance. -1 = the scene's own value

entries.name: r.AutoExposure.MaxEV
entries.help: Brightest adapted exposure the eye adaptation may settle at, in stops (multiplier = 2^EV). Lower it to stop a dark scene being lifted to grey. 999 = the scene's own value

entries.name: r.AutoExposure.Metering
entries.help: Auto-exposure metering override: -1=scene setting, 0=average, 1=spot (center circle), 2=center-weighted, 3=histogram percentile

entries.name: r.AutoExposure.MinEV
entries.help: Darkest adapted exposure the eye adaptation may settle at, in stops (multiplier = 2^EV). 999 = the scene's own value

entries.name: r.AutoExposure.SpeedDown
entries.help: Adaptation rate toward darker scenes (exposure rising), 1/s — dark adaptation is slower. -1 = the scene's own value

entries.name: r.AutoExposure.SpeedUp
entries.help: Adaptation rate toward brighter scenes (exposure falling), 1/s — eyes adapt to light fast. -1 = the scene's own value

entries.name: r.AutoInstancing
entries.help: Collapse identical (mesh, material, LOD) static draws into instanced draws: -1=code default, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.AutoQuality.ForceCores
entries.help: GPU auto-tier: simulate this logical core count (-1 = real machine)

entries.name: r.AutoQuality.ForceIntegrated
entries.help: GPU auto-tier: simulate device type — 0=discrete 1=integrated (-1 = real device)

entries.name: r.AutoQuality.ForceName
entries.help: GPU auto-tier: simulate this device name (empty = real device)

entries.name: r.AutoQuality.ForceRamMB
entries.help: GPU auto-tier: simulate this system RAM size in MB (-1 = real machine)

entries.name: r.AutoQuality.ForceVendor
entries.help: Upscaler auto-pick: simulate this GPU vendor string (empty = real device)

entries.name: r.AutoQuality.ForceVRAMMB
entries.help: GPU auto-tier: simulate this VRAM size in MB (-1 = real device)

entries.name: r.AutoQuality.VendorUpscalers
entries.help: Let the upscaler auto-pick choose a vendor scaler (DLSS/FSR/XeSS) instead of the engine's own TSR. Off by default: the vendor SDKs interpose the graphics API and their process-exit handlers have already proved fragile.

entries.name: r.Bake.MeshCards
entries.help: Cluster mesh surfaces into GI surface-cache card sets in cooked .mmodel (v11): 0=off (the runtime fits one box per instance), 1=on

entries.name: r.Bake.MeshSdf
entries.help: Bake a per-mesh signed distance field into cooked .mmodel (v6): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.Bake.MeshSdf.LiveMaxTriangles
entries.help: Triangle budget for baking a mesh SDF during a live (non-cooked) import; 0 = never bake live, cooked .mmodel only

entries.name: r.Bake.MeshSdfThreads
entries.help: Threads baking mesh SDFs for one model: 0 = every hardware thread, 1 = serial

entries.name: r.BcHdrTextures
entries.help: Block-compress HDR texture sources to BC6H at texture cook (DDC-cached, mips end-to-end): 0=off (raw RGBA16F), 1=on

entries.name: r.BcModelTextures
entries.help: Block-compress decoded model textures at import (albedo/data BC7, normals BC5; DDC-cached): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.BcModelTexturesBC1
entries.help: Fast-path fully-opaque sRGB model textures (albedo/emissive) to BC1 instead of BC7 — half the VRAM of BC7, much faster encode, 565 endpoint quality: 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.BindlessAlbedo
entries.help: Bindless GBuffer material table (albedo + normal/MRA/detail/mask/height): -1=code default, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.Bloom.Mips
entries.help: Bloom mip chain length processed (1..6): -1=tier value

entries.name: r.CapsuleShadows
entries.help: Capsule shadows from skinned meshes with Capsule Shadows on: 0 = off, 1 = on

entries.name: r.CapsuleShadows.DirectStrength
entries.help: How much a capsule shadows the sun (0..1)

entries.name: r.CapsuleShadows.IndirectStrength
entries.help: How much a capsule occludes the sky / indirect light (0..1)

entries.name: r.CapsuleShadows.MaxDistance
entries.help: World distance along the sun ray over which a capsule shadow fades out

entries.name: r.CapsuleShadows.SoftnessAngle
entries.help: Half-angle in degrees of the sun cone a capsule shadow is traced with: wider = softer, further-reaching penumbra

entries.name: r.Clouds.ShadowFootprint
entries.help: World size of the sun-aligned cloud shadow footprint around the camera, snap-stabilized like CSM

entries.name: r.Clouds.ShadowMapSize
entries.help: Cloud shadow map resolution in texels (per side)

entries.name: r.Clouds.Shadows
entries.help: Sun-space cloud transmittance map multiplied into the deferred sun term + froxel fog in-scatter (raymarched clouds only): -1=scalability tier default (High+), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.Clouds.ShadowSamples
entries.help: Density samples of the vertical transmittance integral through the cloud slab (2..8)

entries.name: r.Clouds.ShadowStrength
entries.help: Blend of the cloud transmittance into the sun visibility (0 = no darkening, 1 = full)

entries.name: r.Color.Temperature
entries.help: White-balance override in [-1,1] (cool..warm); < -900 uses the scene's own value

entries.name: r.Color.Tint
entries.help: White-balance tint override in [-1,1] (green..magenta); < -900 uses the scene's own value

entries.name: r.ColorBlind.Mode
entries.help: Accessibility: colour-vision correction after the tonemap, 0 = off, 1 = protanopia, 2 = deuteranopia, 3 = tritanopia (Machado 2009 simulation, the lost difference folded into the channels the viewer keeps)

entries.name: r.ColorBlind.Simulate
entries.help: Accessibility preview: show the frame as a viewer with a colour-vision deficiency sees it, after any correction; 0 = off, 1 = protanopia, 2 = deuteranopia, 3 = tritanopia

entries.name: r.ColorBlind.Strength
entries.help: Accessibility: how much of the colour-vision correction is applied, 0..1

entries.name: r.ColorGradingLUT
entries.help: Color-grading .cube 3D LUT path override: empty=scene setting

entries.name: r.ContactShadowSteps
entries.help: Screen-space contact shadow march steps: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.D3D11.RenderThread
entries.help: D3D11 with the render and RHI threads: 1 = the render thread owns the immediate context and records frame N-1 while the game thread produces N, other threads' buffer/texture writes queue for the next frame's start (FD3D11UploadQueue), 0 = D3D11 runs the frame on the game thread as before. Read when the host starts

entries.name: r.D3D12.AsyncCompute
entries.help: Enable the D3D12 async-compute lane (latched at first use). On by default; 0 records every r.AsyncCompute candidate inline on the direct queue (the escape hatch for a driver whose compute queue is slower than its graphics queue): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.D3D12.AsyncCompute.SyncSubmit
entries.help: 1 = issue the async-compute fork, hand-off and join splits through FRHIThread::ExecuteSync (the render thread waits for the whole RHI queue each time, the pre-2026-10-19 path), 0 = record the split on the render thread and queue only the execute/signal/wait

entries.name: r.D3D12.AsyncUploads
entries.help: Create-with-data uploads on D3D12 (static buffers, texture data) submit their single-time list and return without waiting for the GPU; the staging is released once the list's fence passes. 0 = wait for every upload (the old blocking path)

entries.name: r.D3D12.CopyQueueUploads
entries.help: Create-with-data uploads on D3D12 (fresh static buffers and textures) copy on the COPY queue, and the direct queue waits for them on the GPU instead of running the copies itself. 0 = copy on the direct queue (requires r.D3D12.AsyncUploads to stay non-blocking)

entries.name: r.D3D12.FrameLatencyWaitable
entries.help: Create the D3D12 swapchain with a frame-latency waitable object and block BeginFrame on it, as D3D11 does. Without it the only throttle is the frame fence, which lets DXGI queue its default three presents ahead of the display: 0=off, 1=on (not with a frame-generation proxy swapchain, which owns pacing)

entries.name: r.D3D12.MaxFrameLatency
entries.help: Presents the D3D12 swapchain may queue ahead of the display when r.D3D12.FrameLatencyWaitable is on: 1 = lowest latency, risks a GPU bubble when the CPU frame is long; 0 = FramesInFlight; clamped to FramesInFlight

entries.name: r.DDGI
entries.help: GI DDGI probe-field indirect diffuse (needs the world SDF it traces): -1=tier value, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.DDGI.ProbesPerAxis
entries.help: DDGI probes along each grid axis (8..16, bounds-fit so more = denser): -1=tier value. Applied at startup; a change takes effect on the next launch

entries.name: r.DDGI.RaysPerProbe
entries.help: DDGI rays traced per probe per frame: -1=tier value (live buffer recreate, GI history reset)

entries.name: r.DepthPrepass
entries.help: Depth prepass before the G-buffer (eligible opaque static draws; the G-buffer then shades each visible pixel once): -1=tier value (High+), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.DisplayGamma
entries.help: Accessibility: the gamma the player's panel is assumed to have, 1.8..2.6; the SDR image is re-encoded from 2.2 so a darker panel gets its shadows back

entries.name: r.DisplayLUT
entries.help: OCIO-style display-transform .cube LUT for tonemap operator 5, indexed by the engine's log2 shaper (log2(x / 0.18) from -10 to +6.5 stops): empty=scene setting

entries.name: r.DLSS.Preset
entries.help: DLSS Super Resolution network preset: 0 = driver default, 1 = J (least ghosting, more flicker), 2 = K (transformer, DLAA/Quality/Balanced default), 3 = L (Ultra Performance default, most expensive), 4 = M (Performance default)

entries.name: r.DLSS.RayReconstruction
entries.help: DLSS Ray Reconstruction: while DLSS is the upscaler and the GPU supports it, one NVIDIA model denoises every ray-traced signal (RT reflections, RT/GI, RT shadows, RTAO, MegaLights) and upscales in the same pass; the engine's own denoisers are skipped. 0=off (engine denoisers), 1=on

entries.name: r.DoF.Bokeh
entries.help: DoF blur kernel: -1=scalability tier (Epic+ take the disk), 0=separable gaussian, 1=circular bokeh disk gather + fill

entries.name: r.DynamicRes
entries.help: Dynamic resolution: -1=auto (the shipped runtime turns it on, the editor viewport leaves it off), 1=drive the render scale toward r.DynamicRes.TargetMs from the measured GPU frame time, 0=off (static scale)

entries.name: r.DynamicRes.MaxScale
entries.help: Dynamic resolution upper render-scale bound (0.25..1.0)

entries.name: r.DynamicRes.MinScale
entries.help: Dynamic resolution lower render-scale bound (0.25..1.0). 0.6 rather than 0.5: below about 60% the drop stops being something the upscaler can hide, and a visibly soft frame reads as a broken game rather than a busy one.

entries.name: r.DynamicRes.TargetMs
entries.help: Dynamic resolution GPU frame-time target in milliseconds

entries.name: r.Effects.CullDistanceScale
entries.help: Multiplier on every emitter's authored cull distance: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Effects.LogStats
entries.help: Log particle submission, fill-budget and collision counters every N views (0 = off)

entries.name: r.Effects.MaxActiveEmitters
entries.help: Emitters submitted per view, nearest first: -1=tier value, 0=unlimited

entries.name: r.Effects.MaxParticleScale
entries.help: Multiplier on every emitter's authored pool size: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Effects.OverdrawBudget
entries.help: Screens of particle fill admitted per view: -1=tier value, 0=unlimited

entries.name: r.Effects.SpawnRateScale
entries.help: Multiplier on every emitter's authored spawn rate and burst: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Foliage.DensityScale
entries.help: Foliage scatter density multiplier (scalability tier hook, rebuilds foliage on change)

entries.name: r.Foliage.GPU
entries.help: GPU-instanced foliage: 1 = per-instance GPU culling + indirect draws (default), 0 = legacy CPU-baked cell meshes

entries.name: r.Foliage.GrassDistance
entries.help: Max grass draw distance in world units; blades shrink-fade over the last 25%

entries.name: r.Foliage.ImpostorDistance
entries.help: Distance at which foliage tree meshes hand off to camera-facing impostor cards

entries.name: r.Foliage.LocalShadows
entries.help: GPU grass casts into point/spot shadow atlas tiles whose frustum reaches the field (0 = off; also off when foliage shadow cascades resolve to 0)

entries.name: r.Foliage.ShadowCascades
entries.help: CSM cascades GPU grass casts into (0 = grass shadows off, -1 = scalability tier default; grass sits inside r.Foliage.GrassDistance so the near cascades cover it)

entries.name: r.FrameGeneration
entries.help: Frame generation: 0=off 1=on (swapchain recreates on change)

entries.name: r.FrameGeneration.AutoHold
entries.help: 1 = under VSync, hold frame generation off while the scene already renders at the display refresh (generated frames could not be presented), 0 = engage whenever r.FrameGeneration is on

entries.name: r.FrameGeneration.AutoHold.EngageRatio
entries.help: Frame generation engages once the measured base frame interval exceeds the refresh period times this ratio

entries.name: r.FrameGeneration.Backend
entries.help: Frame-generation backend preference: 0=auto (prefer DLSS-G, then FSR3), 1=FSR3, 2=DLSS-G, 3=XeSS-FG

entries.name: r.FrameGeneration.Dynamic
entries.help: DLSS-G dynamic multi frame generation: 1 = vary the multiplier to hold r.FrameGeneration.TargetFps (needs driver support), 0 = fixed multiplier

entries.name: r.FrameGeneration.EnableForProject
entries.help: Project switch: 1 = this project offers frame generation (DLSS-G, FSR3, XeSS-FG, MetalFX). 0 = r.FrameGeneration is ignored and the player's options hide it

entries.name: r.FrameGeneration.Multiplier
entries.help: Frame generation output multiplier, 2-6 (presented frames per rendered frame). Clamped to what the backend reports for this GPU: DLSS 4 MFG reaches 4x, DLSS 4.5 6x, FSR3 and MetalFX stay at 2x

entries.name: r.FrameGeneration.TargetFps
entries.help: Target presented frame rate for dynamic frame generation, 0 = the display refresh rate

entries.name: r.FSR1.Sharpness
entries.help: FSR1 spatial upscaler RCAS sharpening applied after EASU: 0 = off, 1 = full lobe

entries.name: r.GaussianSplat.MaxPerInstance
entries.help: Most splats one Gaussian splat instance sorts and draws; the LOD chain steps coarser until a level fits (power of two padding, so 1M sorts as 1M)

entries.name: r.GI.AlphaTested
entries.help: Alpha-masked (cutout) geometry in GI/RT. 1 (default) = coverage-aware: the SDF voxelizer dithers a masked draw's occupancy+albedo splat by the albedo texture's average alpha (a 30%-coverage fence registers ~30% of its voxels — occlusion AND bounce scale together), masks sparser than 0.15 skip the distance/albedo splat entirely, and TLAS instances are marked non-opaque so RT reflection/AO ray queries stochastically accept candidates with probability = coverage; 2 = same but very sparse masks (<0.15) still dither instead of skipping (A/B for the sparse verdict); 0 = legacy fully-opaque bias. Flipping forces the next SDF rebuild

entries.name: r.GI.AOWeight
entries.help: How strongly the screen-space AO term (GTAO/RTAO) occludes the DDGI indirect at composite (0=unoccluded probe fill, 1=fully AO-modulated)

entries.name: r.GI.AsyncCompute
entries.help: Record the GI volume update (SDF build, radiance cascades, DDGI probe trace + integrate) on the async-compute lane: forked before the shadow depths, overlapping the raster-bound passes, joined before the first ALU-heavy pass (GTAO, RT sun shadow, MegaLights) or its first consumer (lighting), whichever comes first. 0 = inline, 1 = lane when r.RDG.AsyncCompute allows and the backend has a real second queue

entries.name: r.GI.AsyncCompute.MaxMarchMillions
entries.help: ...and at most this: longer than the raster-bound window it overlaps, the lane makes the first ALU-heavy pass wait for it and the frame loses; 0 = no upper limit

entries.name: r.GI.AsyncCompute.MinMarchMillions
entries.help: The GI update opts into the async lane only while its per-frame probe march (probes x rays per probe x trace steps / radiance-cascade interval, in millions) is at least this: less work than this cannot hide the cross-queue sync it costs

entries.name: r.GI.AsyncGather
entries.help: Run the SDF triangle gather (mesh iteration + soup-cache lookups + shell AABB filter + upload-buffer assembly) on an FTaskGraph worker instead of the render thread. 1=async — submit on the scroll/rebuild/cascade event frame, consume the finished soup when the job lands (the 8-cell scroll dead band absorbs the ~1-frame latency); 0=synchronous (A/B + debugging). The FIRST SDF build always gathers synchronously (startup/PIE/scene-switch correctness over latency)

entries.name: r.GI.Baked
entries.help: Sample the scene's baked GI field (<scene>.mgi) on a tier with live DDGI off: 1 = when present, 0 = never (flat sky ambient, the old Low look)

entries.name: r.GI.BakedSdf.DetailTrace
entries.help: Two-level near detail trace: when the baked composite is active, upload the resident per-mesh baked fields to a GPU atlas + instance table and, in the screen-probe gather and SDF reflections, march the nearby instance fields at their baked resolution BEFORE the 0.25 m global clipmap (per-ray instance list cull). Resolves thin features (wires, fences, mullions, grates) the clipmap fattens or drops. 1=on (default); 0=clipmap-only (A/B). Inert unless the baked composite ran this frame

entries.name: r.GI.BentNormal.Divisor
entries.help: Resolution divisor for the bent-normal filter (floored at r.AO.Divisor); below full res the GI composite upsamples it with a 4-tap depth bilateral: -1=tier value, 1=full res, 2=half

entries.name: r.GI.BentNormalAO
entries.help: Directional bent-normal cone occlusion of the GI gather. 0 = scalar AO multiply (the r.GI.AOWeight fallback), >0 = strength of the extra geometry-directed occlusion where the bent normal (average unoccluded dir from GTAO/RTAO) tilts away from the surface normal in creases/contacts. 1 = full

entries.name: r.GI.DDGI.ColdStartEase
entries.help: With the static SDF no longer scrolling (baked composite), ease the residual DDGI probe cold-start — a freshly-exposed/scrolled probe seeds its irradiance+depth history from the average of its nearest CONVERGED (non-fresh) physical neighbours and eases in (hysteresis 0.75) instead of restarting from 0, so indirect light does not visibly fade in behind camera motion. 1=on (default); 0=legacy cold restart (A/B)

entries.name: r.GI.DDGI.ConvergedFrames
entries.help: Frames with an unchanged light set, SDF and probe grid before the DDGI update is spread across frames (~2x the 0.96 hysteresis' 95 % convergence)

entries.name: r.GI.DDGI.ConvergedInterval
entries.help: Once the DDGI inputs have been static for r.GI.DDGI.ConvergedFrames, trace and integrate the probes one frame in this many; 1 = every frame

entries.name: r.GI.DDGI.Hysteresis
entries.help: Steady-state temporal blend weight of the DDGI probe atlas, in the perceptual space the blend runs in. Lower converges faster and traces noisier; -1 = the 0.96 default (~73 frames to 95% on its own). r.GI.DDGI.React is what shortens it while a change is actually happening

entries.name: r.GI.DDGI.React
entries.help: How sharply a DDGI probe texel shortens its temporal blend when the radiance arriving at it actually changes (per unit relative luma delta above the noise floor of the per-texel change tracker). Without it the blend is a fixed time constant, so a light switching on takes as long to arrive as a 1% drift. 0 = fixed hysteresis (legacy A/B), -1 = tier default

entries.name: r.GI.DDGI.Relocate
entries.help: Nudge each DDGI probe out of geometry along the SDF gradient before it traces: 1=on (default), 0=probes stay on the lattice (A/B — a probe sitting in a wall poisons its whole interpolation cell)

entries.name: r.GI.Denoise
entries.help: GI/reflection denoise mode: -1=tier value, 0=off (raw probe field composited 1:1 — debug/bisect), 1=SVGF-lite (velocity reprojection + disocclusion mask + variance-guided a-trous after temporal)

entries.name: r.GI.DenoiseCompositeTaps
entries.help: Taps of the filtering GI composite (the full-resolution upsample into the HDR): 5 = 5x5, 3 = 3x3 a-trous over the same footprint

entries.name: r.GI.DenoiseHalfRes
entries.help: 1 = run the SVGF temporal and a-trous passes at half resolution and upsample in the filtering composite (r.GI.DenoiseIterations 2 only), 0 = full resolution (A/B)

entries.name: r.GI.DenoiseIterations
entries.help: SVGF a-trous iteration count including the filtering composite (2 or 3). Default 2: measured pixel-equal to 3 on the DDGI room once the variance-guided kernel runs AFTER temporal accumulation, and it keeps the SVGF chain at legacy cost; 3 = the wider (1,2,4) kernel for content that needs it

entries.name: r.GI.EmissiveLights
entries.help: Inject emissive meshes as analytic lights into the DDGI/radiance-cache light list so small/thin emitters that the 0.25 m voxel albedo quantizes away still contribute bounce light. 1=on (default), 0=voxel-emissive only (A/B)

entries.name: r.GI.EmissiveLights.RangeScale
entries.help: Attenuation range of an injected emissive light as a multiple of the mesh bounds radius (clamped to bounds+1 m minimum).

entries.name: r.GI.EmissiveLights.Scale
entries.help: Radiance scale on injected emissive-mesh lights (emissiveColor * emissiveStrength * scale). Tune down if large emitters over-brighten against their voxel-baked emissive term.

entries.name: r.GI.FarCascadeScale
entries.help: Cell of the far GI cascade relative to the near one: 2 = a window twice the near one (64-cell grid at 0.25 m: 32 m), 4 = four times (64 m) at a coarser far field. The near window stays as it is; rays past it march the far field instead of returning sky

entries.name: r.GI.FinalGather
entries.help: GI final gather architecture: -1=tier value (Low/Medium=legacy, High/Epic=screen probes), 0=legacy per-pixel world-probe sampling (DdgiSample), 1=screen-space probe gather (16px tiles + adaptive 8px, SDF-traced, filtered between probes — no probe lattice)

entries.name: r.GI.FoliageMinHeight
entries.help: Shortest foliage (unscaled mesh height, metres) that enters the GI distance field. Grass clumps stay out: a field of them would fill the cells above the ground with solid

entries.name: r.GI.HWRTGather
entries.help: Hardware ray-traced screen-probe final gather — a ray-query variant of the screen-probe trace casts each gather ray at the resident scene TLAS instead of sphere-marching the SDF cascade, then shades the hit from the SAME radiance cache (incl. the r.GI.NearCascade fine cascade), falling back to the flat instance record where the cache is invalid and to sky x SkyScale on miss. Removes SDF quantization from the near-field gather. Importance sampling + MIS integrate + SVGF are unchanged (only the trace backend differs). The Epic and Cinematic rows enable Options.GiHwrtGather; needs the TLAS and falls back to the SDF screen-probe trace (logged once with the reason) when ray query is unavailable. -1=tier value (default), 0=SDF trace, 1=HWRT gather on any tier that runs the screen probes

entries.name: r.GI.ImportanceSample
entries.help: Steer each screen probe's gather rays toward the previous frame's bright octahedral irradiance (the IrrHist guide, already SVGF/temporally smoothed) instead of the uniform octahedral texel set. Each anchor ray inverts the guide's luminance CDF (+ a uniform floor so newly-lit directions are never starved) at a stratified R2 position; the sampled direction + a uniform-relative MIS weight are stored per ray and the integrate pass reconstructs an unbiased cosine-weighted mean — concentrating rays where light is drops variance at equal ray count. Adaptive probes (unstable slots) always sample uniformly. 1=on (default); 0=uniform octahedral (A/B). Requires GiFinalGather; inert on the first frames until the guide history is valid

entries.name: r.GI.ImportanceSample.Floor
entries.help: Uniform floor fraction folded into the importance guide pdf (per-cell luminance floor = Floor x mean guide luminance). ~Floor/(1+Floor) of the probability mass stays uniform so freshly-lit directions the guide has not seen yet are still sampled and can enter the temporal history. 0 = pure luminance-proportional (starves new lights), higher = closer to uniform

entries.name: r.GI.LogVerbose
entries.help: Per-scroll/per-gather GI telemetry (SDF scroll, cascade scroll, DDGI probe scroll, async gather consume): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.GI.NearCascade
entries.help: An optional FINER near radiance cascade for reflection HITS — a second RGBA16F 64^3 cache re-lighting the coarse SDF/albedo at half the near cell (r.GI.NearCascade.Cell, default 0.125 m) over a dim*cell (8 m) window centered on the camera. SdfReflect + RTReflections sample it first at the hit, so near mirror/glossy reflections read the lit surface at 2x the 0.25 m voxel resolution, falling back to the existing cascades outward. Epic-only (the preset row enables Options.GiNearCascade; this cvar gates it within Epic). 1=on (default at Epic); 0=off (A/B). ~2 MB at Epic, zero elsewhere

entries.name: r.GI.NearCascade.Cell
entries.help: The finer near radiance cascade's cell size in world units (default 0.125 m = half the 0.25 m near clipmap). The window extent is dim*cell (8 m at 64^3), so a smaller cell sharpens reflections over a smaller near volume. Clamped to [0.03125, 0.25]

entries.name: r.GI.NeuralCache
entries.help: Neural irradiance cache: 1 = the GI buffer's indirect diffuse comes from a hash-grid + MLP trained online from one-bounce rays traced off the G-Buffer every frame (NRC-style), instead of the DDGI field / screen-probe gather; 0 = off

entries.name: r.GI.NeuralCache.Ema
entries.help: Decay of the exponential moving average of the weights the per-pixel query reads (0 = the raw weights; higher is steadier and slower to follow a change)

entries.name: r.GI.NeuralCache.GridLearningRate
entries.help: Adam learning rate of the neural cache's hash-grid features

entries.name: r.GI.NeuralCache.LearningRate
entries.help: Adam learning rate of the neural cache's MLP weights

entries.name: r.GI.NeuralCache.Samples
entries.help: Training rays a frame for the neural irradiance cache (1024..65536)

entries.name: r.GI.ProbeTraceSteps
entries.help: Sphere-march step cap for DDGI world-probe rays (far cascade adds +1/3): -1=tier value

entries.name: r.GI.RadianceBlend
entries.help: Fraction of the PREVIOUS radiance-cache bake a cadence bake keeps while the lighting is still converging. The cache is a step input to reflections and the screen-probe gather, so a bake that lands the whole change at once pops; keeping part of it turns the cadence into a geometric ramp. 0 = legacy hard replace, 0.5 (default) = halve every tick. The first bake, a geometry edit and the idle refresh always replace

entries.name: r.GI.RadianceDirty
entries.help: Dirty-region radiance-cache rebake: 1 = light-hash gated (full bakes only during the post-change convergence window + a slow heartbeat; toroidal scrolls re-bake just the exposed slabs), 0 = legacy full-volume bake every GiRadianceInterval frames (A/B)

entries.name: r.GI.RadianceHeartbeatSlices
entries.help: How many interleaved phases the idle radiance-cache refresh is split into. Outside the convergence window the cache drifts against the probe field; refreshing the whole volume in one dispatch is a hard discontinuity roughly once a second. Each slice re-bakes 1/N of the voxels on a diagonal phase pattern, N times as often, so a trilinear fetch always mixes refreshed and retained voxels. 1 = legacy single full refresh

entries.name: r.GI.RadianceInterval
entries.help: Frames between surface radiance-cache rebuilds: -1=tier value, 1=every frame

entries.name: r.GI.RayTerminateCache
entries.help: A screen-probe ray with no NEAR hit inside a small fine-march budget terminates into the far-cascade world radiance cache — a bounded coarse march of the far SDF, shaded from the far radiance cascade (which already carries multibounce via the DDGI probe feedback) — instead of fine-marching the full clipmap chain. Bounds the fine-step cost AND gives cache-fed near-infinite bounce. The far cache is coarse: an accepted bias for the far/indirect tail. 1=on (default); 0=full-chain march (A/B). Only active when a far cascade exists (fitting scenes run a single cascade in either SDF mode; non-fitting baked scenes composite a far cascade too, so this is live on cooked content)

entries.name: r.GI.ReflectTraceSteps
entries.help: Sphere-march step cap for the SDF reflection leg (far cascade adds +2/5): -1=tier value

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.Budget
entries.help: Adaptive screen-probe budget on top of the per-16px-tile anchors (~8k anchors at 1080p): extra 8px probes allocated where a tile spans a depth/normal discontinuity; 0 disables adaptive subdivision

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.HalfRateConverged
entries.help: Trace converged anchor probes on alternate frames in a tile checkerboard, carrying their history forward in between: 0 = every probe every frame

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.HalfRateMinFrames
entries.help: History length (frames) an anchor probe needs before the half-rate update may rest it

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.IndirectLaunch
entries.help: Launch the screen-probe trace/filter/guide/integrate passes from the live probe count (1) instead of the full probe capacity (0, the A/B reference)

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.Rays
entries.help: Rays traced per screen probe per frame (upper hemisphere of the octahedral set): -1=tier value, else 16..256 (rounded to the octahedral resolution)

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.TemporalAccum
entries.help: Per-probe irradiance temporal accumulation: 1 = each anchor screen probe converges to a multi-frame average (kills the tile-coherent Monte-Carlo flicker the downstream full-res SVGF cannot remove — a static floor probe reaches a fixed value), 0 = fresh single-frame integrate (legacy A/B). Anchors only; adaptive probes always integrate fresh

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.TemporalAlphaMin
entries.help: Floor on a screen probe's per-frame blend weight — the accumulated average never fully freezes, so a slow real change still creeps in even at the history cap

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.TemporalMaxFrames
entries.help: Cap on a screen probe's effective history length (frames). A converged static probe averages this many frames; a radiance-reactive rate shortens it where the traced radiance actually changed so movers do not ghost

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.TemporalReact
entries.help: How sharply a screen probe drops its history when the traced radiance changes (per unit relative luma delta above the ~20% noise floor). Higher = snappier moving-bleed response, lower = smoother

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenProbes.TraceSteps
entries.help: Sphere-march step cap for screen-probe rays (far cascade adds +1/2): -1=tier value

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenTraces
entries.help: Screen-space first trace leg of the screen-probe gather (the Lumen model): each probe ray FIRST marches the GBuffer depth buffer and shades a hit from the current frame's lit HDR scene color (pre-exposure divided out); only rays that miss, leave the screen or pass behind known geometry continue into the SDF cascade march / HWRT ray query from where the screen march ended. Gives real contact GI and makes dynamic/skinned geometry — present in the depth buffer, absent from the static SDF — occlude and bounce in the gather. 1=on (default at every tier the screen probes run); 0=world-only trace (A/B)

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenTraces.Steps
entries.help: Linear depth-march step count of the screen-trace leg (plus a 5-iteration bisection refine on the first crossing). More steps catch thinner on-screen blockers at higher cost; clamped 4..64

entries.name: r.GI.ScreenTraces.Thickness
entries.help: Depth-band thickness (world units) a screen-trace crossing must land inside to count as a hit; deeper crossings are treated as silhouette jumps and hand the ray to the world leg. Larger accepts more grazing hits (and more silhouette leaks)

entries.name: r.GI.SDFResolution
