entries.help: World-SDF clipmap dimension (cubed): -1 = tier/Options value (Cinematic 128, else 64), else 32..256 (snapped even). Higher = a larger, higher-fidelity GI field at Cinematic cost. Applied live — the field, the radiance cache and the DDGI history rebuild over the following frames.

entries.name: r.GI.SkinnedSdf
entries.help: Skinned meshes in the GI distance field: 1 = a posed character occludes and bounces light — the runtime voxelizer re-voxelizes the cells around each moved pose, the baked composite places one rigid field per bone; 0 = skinned meshes are left out of the field (the old behaviour)

entries.name: r.GI.SkinnedSdfInterval
entries.help: Frames between skinned-mesh updates of the GI distance field (1 = every frame). A pose change waits at most this long to reach the field

entries.name: r.GI.SkyScale
entries.help: Scale on probe-miss sky radiance in the DDGI trace — art-directable control over how much sky colour fills shadows outdoors

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache
entries.help: GI surface cache (the Lumen mesh-card analogue): 0=off — ray hits shade the flat per-draw voxel albedo; 1=on — static opaque mesh instances are captured into an albedo/normal/emissive/depth card atlas, relit on a budget, and sampled at ray hits with the voxel field as the fallback. The atlas is allocated on the first resident card, so a scene with nothing to card pays nothing; every consumer is bit-identical to the voxel path when it is off

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache.AtlasSize
entries.help: Card-atlas edge in texels (256..4096, snapped down to a power of two); -1 = tier value (1024 up to High, 2048 at Epic+). Three RGBA16F capture targets, one RGBA16F lit target and a D32F depth target are allocated at this size — 1024 costs about 36 MB, 2048 about 144 MB

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache.CaptureBudget
entries.help: Card slots re-rasterized per capture event (0 = no limit). This is what bounds the raster spike: a scene that invalidates every slot at once refills over several capture events instead of one, and every slot not yet captured simply has no card, which every consumer already handles

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache.CaptureInterval
entries.help: Minimum frames between two card captures. A capture re-rasterizes only the card slots whose content hash moved (resident draw, its transform, its material texture version, the atlas tiles it holds), so a still scene captures once and never again and one moving object costs one instance, not the whole set

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache.CardResolution
entries.help: MAXIMUM texels per card edge (8..256, snapped down to a power of two); -1 = tier value (64 Low/Medium, 128 High, 256 Epic+). A card is sized from its own screen coverage between MinCardResolution and this; the ceiling is what stops one wall the camera stands against from consuming the whole atlas

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache.CardsPerInstance
entries.help: Cards one instance may take from its mesh's offline set (1..32). A mesh cooked with a card set covers a concave shape with several oriented boxes instead of one; each card costs a record and up to six atlas tiles, so this is the ceiling that stops one L-shaped building consuming the budget. 1 = the single fitted box the cache used before card sets

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache.CoverageStats
entries.help: Card-coverage census: 0 = off, N = sample every Nth pixel of the GBuffer and run the consumers' own card lookup over it, reporting the covered fraction through GetGiCardCoverage(). Debug only — it costs a dispatch and a GPU->CPU readback, and the readback is a few frames latent

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache.Instances
entries.help: Maximum mesh instances resident in the card atlas, clamped by the atlas tile count and by the shader's GI_CARD_MAX_INSTANCES ceiling of 256. The resident set is the highest-scoring draws by apparent size, so the cards follow the camera

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache.LightSlices
entries.help: Interleaved phases the card relight is spread over (1..16). Each frame relights 1/N of the atlas texels, so a moving light reaches the cache continuously instead of landing as one full-atlas step every N frames. Freshly captured tiles ignore the phase and relight whole, because their texels still hold the previous occupant's radiance

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache.MinCardResolution
entries.help: MINIMUM texels per card edge (8..64, snapped down to a power of two, clamped below CardResolution). Also the block edge the relight work list is built in, so lowering it makes that list finer and larger

entries.name: r.GI.SurfaceCache.TexelDensity
entries.help: Card texels per screen pixel of the card's own world edge. A card is a GI bounce source, not a visible surface, so one texel per sixteen pixels is already finer than the probe grid that reads it — raise it only when card-lit detail is visibly blocky in a mirror

entries.name: r.GI.TemporalClampFloor
entries.help: SVGF temporal variance-clip floor as a fraction of the local mean. The clip half-width never drops below floor*mean, so locally-flat GI/reflection regions keep integrating the designed per-frame jitter instead of the history being crushed to the current frame (visible as shaking). 0 = legacy tight clip

entries.name: r.GI.TemporalMinHistory
entries.help: SVGF temporal floor on the effective history length for reprojected pixels — movers ease over at least this many frames instead of snapping to the current frame. Disocclusions still restart at 1

entries.name: r.GI.TemporalVelocityScale
entries.help: SVGF temporal history shortening per pixel of reprojection speed (Neff = N / (1 + scale*velPix)). Lower = smoother motion response, higher = more reactive/raw. Was hardcoded 0.25

entries.name: r.GI.TerrainFoliage
entries.help: Terrain and foliage in the GI distance field: 1 = every field window takes the min with the CDLOD terrain's heightfield and with a capsule per tall foliage instance, so both occlude and bounce light; 0 = both are invisible to GI (the old behaviour)

entries.name: r.GI.TextureTint
entries.help: Multiply the SDF voxelizer's flat per-draw albedo by the material's average albedo-texture color (linear, baked at texture cook / computed at load) so GI bounce, the radiance cache, SDF/RT reflections and screen-probe hits carry the texture's actual tint. 1=on (default), 0=flat legacy base color (A/B). Flipping forces the next SDF rebuild

entries.name: r.GI.Translucency
entries.help: Translucency GI: 1=forward transparents (glass/water) sample the DDGI probe field per pixel as their ambient term when DDGI is active (default), 0=flat ambient (A/B)

entries.name: r.GiCascades
entries.help: GI clipmap cascades: 2=near window + far cascade, 3=+a third, wider cascade; the far ones are only active when the scene outgrows cascade 0's window. Applies to BOTH SDF builds — the runtime voxelize scroll chain and the baked composite (which fills the coarse window from the same resident baked fields)

entries.name: r.GlobalIllumination.EnableForProject
entries.help: Project switch: 1 = this project uses dynamic global illumination (DDGI, screen probes, the GI scene SDF, SSGI, the neural cache). 0 = no scalability tier, device profile or r.* cvar turns it on, and its targets and pipelines are never built

entries.name: r.GpuCull.ClassicDirect
entries.help: How the classic (non-meshlet) GBuffer path draws GPU-culled candidates: 0 = one indirect draw per candidate off the cull's argument buffer (GPU occlusion decides), 1 = directly from the CPU frustum test (the cull still runs for meshlets), -1 = the backend's RendererCapabilities::CheapPerDrawIndirect decides

entries.name: r.GpuDrivenCull
entries.help: GPU compute frustum/Hi-Z cull + indirect draws: -1=code default, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.GpuMarkers
entries.help: Name every GPU scope for capture tools (PIX / RenderDoc / Nsight / Xcode events): 0=off, 1=on. Independent of r.GpuTimings

entries.name: r.GpuScene.ClassicSlots
entries.help: Give every non-instanced static draw a stable GPU-scene slot and have the classic G-Buffer, CSM and local-shadow vertex stages read its matrix from the GPU scene instead of the push block: 1 = on, 0 = push the model per draw (A/B)

entries.name: r.GpuScene.CompactRuns
entries.help: 1 = pack each live-MDI run's surviving instanced-group commands on the GPU and draw them with one DrawIndexedIndirectCount; 0 = the MultiDraw over every command of the run (A/B)

entries.name: r.GpuScene.DirtyUpload
entries.help: Write only the changed ranges of the per-frame instance-transform and previous-model pools (each frame-in-flight buffer keeps a CPU copy of what it holds): 1=on, 0=write every buffer whole (A/B)

entries.name: r.GpuScene.PlanCache
entries.help: Keep the G-Buffer plan's material/mesh decisions (bindless residency of the material maps, resolved graph pipelines) across frames per primitive and rebuild them only when the material snapshot, the mesh's meshlet state, a plan-wide setting or the bindless table changes: 1 = on, 0 = resolve every draw every frame (A/B)

entries.name: r.GpuScene.PrevBySlot
entries.help: Keep a previous-frame matrix per GPU-scene slot and have the instanced velocity draw read it through each member's slot: 1 = on, 0 = repack the previous models in member order every frame (A/B)

entries.name: r.GpuScene.ShadowRuns
entries.help: CSM casters through the GPU scene's buckets: 1 = opaque pool-resident instanced groups (lone draws included under r.GpuScene.SingleDraws) are culled per cascade on the GPU and each run of them draws with one DrawIndexedIndirectCount per cascade; 0 = one instanced draw per group per cascade with every member in it (A/B)

entries.name: r.GpuScene.SingleDraws
entries.help: With GPU-driven culling on: 1 = every eligible static draw joins the GPU scene's instanced buckets, a lone draw as a group of one, and the groups are ordered by material so a whole bucket is one count-compacted indirect draw; 0 = only meshes repeated AutoInstancingMinCount times are grouped and lone draws push their model (A/B)

entries.name: r.GpuTimings
entries.help: Record per-pass GPU timestamps: 0=off (a scope costs nothing and the per-frame resolve, which blocks on Vulkan, never runs), 1=on. Default on in debug/dev/debuggame, off in profile/release

entries.name: r.Grid.Spacing
entries.help: Viewport grid minor cell size in world units, overriding Options::GridSpacing. 0 = use the scene/editor value

entries.name: r.GTAO
entries.help: Ground-truth ambient occlusion slice: -1=tier value (Medium+ on, Low hard-off), 0=off, 1=on. Scene PostFX settings act within this.

entries.name: r.GTAO.Slices
entries.help: GTAO horizon slices per pixel: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.HairStrands
entries.help: Draw hair strands (Hair Strands components) into the G-buffer: 0 = off, 1 = on

entries.name: r.HairStrands.Density
entries.help: Fraction of each groom's render strands drawn (0.05..1): the guides always simulate, fewer children are interpolated and drawn

entries.name: r.HDRMaxNits
entries.help: HDR output: peak luminance in nits used for the highlight rolloff.

entries.name: r.HDROutput
entries.help: HDR display output: 0=SDR, 1=scRGB (RGBA16F linear), 2=HDR10 (RGB10A2 PQ), 3=auto (prefer scRGB). Falls back to SDR when the surface offers no HDR formats.

entries.name: r.HDRPaperWhiteNits
entries.help: HDR output: luminance in nits that scene value 1.0 (SDR white) maps to.

entries.name: r.HeightFog
entries.help: Exponential height fog from an ExponentialHeightFog actor: 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.HiZ.LogOcclusion
entries.help: Read the GPU occlusion counters back and log, every 300 frames, how many classic draws and instances the Hi-Z pyramid rejected — the measure r.HiZ.Size is judged by. 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.HiZ.Size
entries.help: Side of the Hi-Z max-depth pyramid the occlusion culls test against, in texels (128..1024, rounded up to a power of two; read when a renderer initializes)

entries.name: r.InstancingPlan.Cache
entries.help: Reuse last frame's instancing groups (which draw joined which group, bucket order) while every draw's key, the moving-body and meshlet flags, the plan switches and the geometry-pool residency are unchanged: 1=on, 0=rebuild every frame

entries.name: r.Lighting.Classify
entries.help: Let the GPU pick the deferred-lighting variant per frame from the G-Buffer: 1 = the variant without the extended lobes (anisotropy, clear coat, Substrate, hair, subsurface, cloth, foliage, eye, iridescence) whenever no pixel takes one; 0 = always the full shader; 2 = always the simple one (diagnostic: extended surfaces lose their lobes)

entries.name: r.LocalExposure
entries.help: Local exposure override: -1 = use the scene setting, 0 = off, 1 = on

entries.name: r.LOD.ErrorPixels
entries.help: Screen-space error budget, in pixels, a mesh's coarser LOD may show before the finer one takes over; a mesh whose simplifier recorded its error gets its own coverage boundaries from this, others keep r.LOD1/LOD2 coverage. 0 = always use the global boundaries

entries.name: r.LOD1Coverage
entries.help: Screen-coverage threshold below which a static mesh drops to LOD1: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.LOD1TriangleRatio
entries.help: Target triangle ratio for generated LOD1 (fraction of the source mesh, 0..1)

entries.name: r.LOD2Coverage
entries.help: Screen-coverage threshold below which a static mesh drops to LOD2: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.LOD2TriangleRatio
entries.help: Target triangle ratio for generated LOD2 (fraction of the source mesh, 0..1)

entries.name: r.LODCrossfadeTime
entries.help: Dithered LOD crossfade window in seconds: during a switch both levels draw with complementary screen-door masks; 0 = instant switch

entries.name: r.LogGpuScopes
entries.help: Log per-scope GPU averages (all nesting depths, amortized per frame) every N frames (0=off) — per-pass GPU budget evidence

entries.name: r.LogGpuTimings
entries.help: Log resolved GPU pass timings every N frames (0=off) — headless perf profiling until Snowcap lands

entries.name: r.LowLatency
entries.help: Low latency: 0=off, 1=on, 2=on+boost. Drives NVIDIA Reflex, AMD Anti-Lag 2 or Intel XeLL, whichever this GPU runs (see r.LowLatency.Backend); a live DLSS-G or XeSS-FG keeps it on

entries.name: r.LowLatency.Backend
entries.help: Low-latency runtime: 0=auto (whichever this GPU runs), 1=NVIDIA Reflex, 2=AMD Anti-Lag 2, 3=Intel XeLL; an unsupported pick falls back to auto

entries.name: r.Material.ClearCoat
entries.help: Clear-coat second specular lobe (opaque deferred + forward translucent). 0=off (bit-identical to a coatless material), 1=on

entries.name: r.Material.MaxStaticPermutations
entries.help: Most shader permutations one material's static switches may produce (2^switches). A graph past it fails to compile with the switch named.

entries.name: r.MaterialMipBias.Auto
entries.help: Bias every material texture sample by log2(render/output) while a temporal upscaler reconstructs the output grid (one level more for FSR/DLSS/XeSS, per their SDKs): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.MaterialMipBias.Min
entries.help: Floor of the automatic material mip bias: past -2 the texture cache thrashes for detail the resolve cannot hold

entries.name: r.MaterialMipBias.Offset
entries.help: Extra material texture LOD bias in mip levels, added on top of the automatic one: negative = sharper

entries.name: r.MaterialProxyReuse
entries.help: 1 = reuse a material's render snapshot while its state version is unchanged; 0 = copy every material every frame (A/B)

entries.name: r.MaxAnisotropy
entries.help: Sampler max anisotropy ceiling for newly created samplers: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.MaxImportTextureSize
entries.help: Default cap for model-import textures larger than this (power-of-two box filter); 0 = unlimited. A texture's own Max Size in its .mdfmeta overrides it

entries.name: r.MegaLights
entries.help: MegaLights-style stochastic many-shadowed-light sampling for the local shadow-casters past the atlas budget (needs clustered lighting): -1=tier value (Epic+), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.MegaLights.CheapMode
entries.help: Cheap screen-space fallback shadow for shadow-casting local lights denied an atlas tile while MegaLights is off (a short contact-style depth march toward the light): -1=tier value (High/Medium on), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.MegaLights.Denoise
entries.help: MegaLights spatiotemporal denoise: 0=raw stochastic result (A/B only), 1=temporal reproject + variance-guided spatial filter

entries.name: r.MegaLights.EnableForProject
entries.help: Project switch: 1 = this project uses MegaLights stochastic many-light shadows. 0 = shadowed local lights past the atlas take the cheap screen-space march

entries.name: r.MegaLights.FireflyClamp
entries.help: MegaLights per-sample luminance clamp bounding one ray's contribution before the denoiser; higher admits brighter spikes

entries.name: r.MegaLights.Samples
entries.help: Local lights importance-sampled + shadow-traced per pixel per frame (1..4): -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Mesh.CompactIndices
entries.help: Upload a mesh's indices at 16 bits when it addresses at most 65 536 vertices: 1 = on (half the index memory and bandwidth), 0 = always 32-bit

entries.name: r.MeshDrawCommands.Cache
entries.help: Persistent static draw commands per primitive (entity, submesh): built once and reused while mesh, material, transform and flags are unchanged, with the material snapshot revalidated instead of looked up and the LOD state reached without a lookup; LOD and visibility stay per frame. 1 = on, 0 = rebuild every command every frame (A/B)

entries.name: r.MeshDrawCommands.Stats
entries.help: Log [MeshDrawCommands] built/reused/re-snapshotted static draw commands every N scenes: 0 = off

entries.name: r.Meshlet.ComputeFallback
entries.help: Meshlet compute fallback for GPUs without mesh shaders: the batched material runs are culled per cluster by compute into one triangle list and drawn with one indexed-indirect draw each, the vertex stage pulling from the meshlet pool. 0 = off (no mesh shaders keeps the classic raster path), 1 = on where mesh shaders are missing, 2 = forced on every GPU (A/B against the mesh-shading path)

entries.name: r.Meshlet.Displacement
entries.help: Nanite-style displacement: a static uber material with a Height Map and Displacement > 0 moves its meshlet-path vertices along their normals in the mesh stage: 0 = off, 1 = on

entries.name: r.Meshlet.GBufferBatch
entries.help: Draw every static meshlet GBuffer draw that shares a material in ONE dispatch over a flattened task-group list (per-draw transforms, cluster ranges and visibility slots in a record buffer): 1 = on, 0 = one push + dispatch per draw

entries.name: r.Meshlet.PageKB
entries.help: Target size in KB of one meshlet streaming page (its vertex slice + remap + packed triangles; cluster records stay reserved).

entries.name: r.Meshlet.PageOpsPerFrame
entries.help: Ceiling on meshlet page uploads/releases per frame.

entries.name: r.Meshlet.Paging
entries.help: Cluster paging for the meshlet pool: keep only the pages the DAG cut can reach resident (1) or hold every mesh whole (0).

entries.name: r.Meshlet.ShadowBatch
entries.help: Draw every static meshlet CSM caster of a cascade in ONE mesh-shading dispatch over a flattened task-group list (1, default) instead of one dispatch per caster per cascade (0). Skinned casters keep their own dispatch either way

entries.name: r.Meshlet.ShadowLodError
entries.help: Cluster-DAG cut budget for meshlet CSM casters, in SHADOW-MAP TEXELS of allowed projected error (a cascade's projection is orthographic, so this does not vary with distance). -1 = use r.MeshletLodError; larger = coarser casters

entries.name: r.Meshlet.Shadows
entries.help: Render meshlet-eligible CSM casters (static + skinned) through the depth-only mesh-shading path with a per-cascade cluster-DAG LOD cut + per-cluster light-frustum culling: 0=off, 1=on, -1 = follow r.MeshletGBuffer. Requires VK_EXT_mesh_shader; casters fall back to the raster shadow path otherwise

entries.name: r.Meshlet.Skinned
entries.help: Route skeletal meshes through the mesh-shading GBuffer path (compute pre-skin into a per-instance vertex buffer + per-cluster bounds refit each frame): 0=off, 1=on, -1 = follow r.MeshletGBuffer. Requires VK_EXT_mesh_shader; skinned draws stay on the GPU-skinned raster path otherwise

entries.name: r.Meshlet.SwRaster
entries.help: Software-rasterize sub-pixel meshlet clusters in compute into a visibility buffer, resolved back into the GBuffer by one screen pass for every table-resident material plus one per material that needs its own descriptor set, instead of emitting them as mesh workgroups: 0=off, 1=on. Needs the meshlet path (VK_EXT_mesh_shader / SM6.5) and both MeshletSwRaster + MeshletSwResolve shipped

entries.name: r.Meshlet.SwRaster.IndirectLaunch
entries.help: Size the software rasterizer's depth and payload launches to the clusters the task stages appended (an indirect dispatch the GPU fills) instead of to every cluster they tested: 1 = indirect, 0 = the tested-count upper bound

entries.name: r.Meshlet.SwRasterDrawPixels
entries.help: Per-DRAW ceiling on the software path: a draw whose whole bounding sphere projects wider than this keeps every cluster on hardware. Clusters never project larger than the draw holding them, so a big draw would buy a resolve screen pass for a handful of software pixels. 0 = no ceiling

entries.name: r.Meshlet.SwRasterPixels
entries.help: The hardware/software split: a surviving cluster whose projected screen diameter is at or under this many pixels goes to the compute rasterizer (its ~124 triangles are then at or under a pixel each). Clamped to 1..127 — the threshold rides 7 free bits of the meshlet push block's CullFlags

entries.name: r.MeshletGBuffer
entries.help: Mesh-shading GBuffer path for meshes with import-built cluster DAGs (screen-space-error LOD cut + per-meshlet frustum/cone/Hi-Z cull + residency streaming): 0=off, 1=on, -1 = scalability tier default (Epic+). Requires VK_EXT_mesh_shader; without it every draw keeps the raster path and the fallback reason is logged once

entries.name: r.MeshletIdleFrames
entries.help: Evict resident clusters whose mesh has not drawn for this many frames, so a scene change or a walked-away region releases pool space and its mesh. 0 = keep until the budget forces it out

entries.name: r.MeshletLodError
entries.help: Cluster-DAG LOD cut threshold in screen pixels: a meshlet renders when its projected simplification error is under this while its parent's is not; 0 = full detail (leaves only)

entries.name: r.MeshletOcclusionCull
entries.help: Per-meshlet Hi-Z occlusion in the task shader (two-phase, needs r.GpuDrivenCull occlusion feeding the pyramid): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.MeshletPoolBudget
entries.help: Resident cluster budget in meshlets; meshes past it evict the least-recently-drawn and stream back in on demand. 0 = the pool's full capacity

entries.name: r.MeshletResidencyStats
entries.help: Log [MeshletResidency] admissions/evictions/rejections and resident bytes every N frames: 0=off

entries.name: r.Meshlets
entries.help: Build meshlet clusters at import for the mesh-shading path: -1=code default (ON when the GPU has mesh shaders), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.MeshletStats
entries.help: Log [Meshlet] task-cull telemetry (tested/drawn/killed per test) every N frames: 0=off

entries.name: r.MeshLOD
entries.help: Coverage-based discrete mesh LOD (terrain chunks carry LOD chains): -1=code default, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.MeshLODBias
entries.help: LOD bias in levels: every LOD boundary moves this many levels closer to the camera (coverage is scaled by the LOD1->LOD2 ratio per level), so coarser LODs come sooner while a close object keeps LOD0: -1 = use the active scalability tier, >=0 = explicit bias

entries.name: r.MeshRenderProxies
entries.help: Mesh gather walks the persistent render proxies, rebuilt only on a structural ECS change (1, default), or looks every entity's components up again each view (0, for A/B)

entries.name: r.MeshStreaming
entries.help: Stream static-mesh LOD residency: 1 = register LOD-carrying meshes with the streaming manager in a host that drives it (evict/restore per level, default), 0 = everything stays resident

entries.name: r.MeshStreaming.PoolSizeMB
entries.help: Streaming mesh residency budget in MB (0 = unlimited). The least-recently-drawn meshes coarsen first when the resident pool exceeds it.

entries.name: r.Metal.CaptureFrame
entries.help: Capture the next GPU frame to a .gputrace under <cwd>/Captures (open in Xcode). Needs MTL_CAPTURE_ENABLED=1. Resets to 0 after the capture

entries.name: r.Metal.MeshShaders
entries.help: Metal mesh shaders from Metal Shader Converter metallib blobs: 1=report SupportsMeshShaders when the device has mesh support, 0=vertex fallback. Experimental — Mac-unverified

entries.name: r.Metal.MTL4
entries.help: Metal 4 command model: 1=MTL4 command queue + per-slot command allocators + argument-table binding when the runtime supports it (macOS 26), 0=classic MTLCommandBuffer path. Mac-unverified dual path — see Documentation/ROADMAP.md §12.7 (was plan item 12)

entries.name: r.MetalFX.Denoised
entries.help: MetalFX resolve variant when the renderer supplies the GBuffer aux inputs (diffuse albedo / normals / roughness): 1=MTLFXTemporalDenoisedScaler when the device supports it (denoise + upscale in one pass — the RT-effects path), 0=always the plain MTLFXTemporalScaler

entries.name: r.MetalFX.Subsume
entries.help: When the MetalFX denoised resolve runs, let it own denoising: skip the per-effect stochastic temporal filters (RTAO/RT-shadow accumulation, MegaLights denoise, GI SVGF) and feed the raw signal. 0=keep the engine's filters (default), 1=hand denoising to MetalFX

entries.name: r.MinScreenCoverage
entries.help: Small-object cull: a static mesh whose world sphere covers less than this fraction of the vertical FOV is dropped from every pass: -1=tier value, 0=off

entries.name: r.MotionBlurObject
entries.help: Per-object motion blur: 1=sample the velocity prepass in the MB pass when available (default), 0=camera reprojection only

entries.name: r.OcclusionCull
entries.help: Hi-Z occlusion cull of main-view static meshes against last frame's depth pyramid: -1=tier value, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.OIT
entries.help: Weighted-blended order-independent transparency for the standard translucent path (water keeps the sorted pass). 0=off (sorted alpha), 1=on.

entries.name: r.ParallelRecord
entries.help: Parallel GBuffer/shadow/velocity command recording into secondary CBs: -1=code default, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.ParallelRecordMinDraws
entries.help: Minimum draw count before parallel recording engages: -1=code default (64), N=override (0 forces it on tiny scenes — debug)

entries.name: r.ParallelSubmit
entries.help: Parallel static-mesh visibility/LOD resolve at EndScene (bounds + frustum + coverage fan out to workers, LOD hysteresis stays serial in submit order): 0=legacy per-submit path, 1=on

entries.name: r.PathTracer.Denoise
entries.help: Edge-avoiding a-trous denoiser over the path-tracer accumulation: 1=on (default — a restarted accumulation is 1 spp and reads as noise without it), 0=off (raw reference, byte-identical, for comparisons).

entries.name: r.PathTracer.Enable
entries.help: Progressive path-traced reference render: 0=off, 1=on. Forces the tracer on regardless of the editor view mode (offline/screenshot capture); the 'Path Tracing' view mode enables it in the editor without this flag. Session only: no config file applies it.

entries.name: r.PathTracer.FireflyClamp
entries.help: Per-sample radiance clamp before accumulation, in exposed units (the clamp scales by 1/pre-exposure like every other radiance ceiling); 0 = unbounded

entries.name: r.PathTracer.FurnaceSky
entries.help: White-furnace check: > 0 replaces the scene's sky with a uniform one of this radiance and drops the sun and the local lights, so a convex object of albedo a must converge to a times it and never above it (energy conservation); 0 = the scene's own lighting

entries.name: r.PathTracer.MaxBounces
entries.help: Maximum path bounces per camera ray (1..32). More bounces resolve deeper indirect light.

entries.name: r.PathTracer.MaxSamples
entries.help: Samples per pixel after which accumulation stops and the converged image is held (0 = never stop). Without a limit the tracer kept spending the GPU on an image that had stopped changing.

entries.name: r.PathTracer.SamplesPerFrame
entries.help: Camera path samples accumulated per pixel each frame (1..16). Higher converges faster but costs more per frame.

entries.name: r.PathTracer.Textures
entries.help: Path tracer hits sample the material's albedo, normal and metallic-roughness maps at the hit UV (needs the bindless table and 64-bit shader integers): 1 = on, 0 = each instance's average colour, vertex normal and scalar roughness/metallic, the old flat shading (A/B)

entries.name: r.Physics.AutoCollider
entries.help: Give a freshly placed mesh the collider its mesh asks for — the authored .mmeshmeta setup, else a primitive fitted to the mesh bounds. 0 places meshes with no collider at all

entries.name: r.PipelineCacheSaveInterval
entries.help: Seconds of pipeline-creation quiet before the VkPipelineCache is flushed to disk mid-session (crash-safe persistence): 0 = only on clean shutdown

entries.name: r.PointCloud.ComputeRaster
entries.help: Rasterise the scan layer in compute (one thread a point, GPU LOD, a 64-bit atomic min per pixel) where the device has 64-bit buffer atomics: 0 = always the splat draw

entries.name: r.PointCloud.Density
entries.help: Player scan density, 0.5..1.5: below 1 the renderer draws a stable thinned subset, above 1 the scan loop fires more rays per shot

entries.name: r.PointCloud.EDL
entries.help: Eye-dome lighting on the scan layer: darkens a splat by how far its neighbours sit in front of it, so edges and creases read without any light

entries.name: r.PointCloud.EDLRadius
entries.help: Eye-dome lighting sample radius in layer pixels

entries.name: r.PointCloud.EDLStrength
entries.help: Eye-dome lighting strength (Boucheny scale; 1 is a visible edge, 0 off)

entries.name: r.PointCloud.Ephemeral.Capacity
entries.help: Points the decaying half of a scanned cloud may hold before the oldest is evicted; -1 = the cloud's own value, 0 = drop dynamic hits entirely

entries.name: r.PointCloud.Ephemeral.Lifetime
entries.help: How long an ephemeral point lives, in ephemeral ticks (60/s); -1 = the cloud's own value

entries.name: r.PointCloud.FlashLimit
entries.help: Limit how fast the scan layer's mean luminance may rise (photosensitivity); 0 composites every reveal at once

entries.name: r.PointCloud.FlashRiseSeconds
entries.help: Shortest time over which the scan layer may rise by r.PointCloud.FlashStep; never below 0.1 s, the minimum a reveal may take

entries.name: r.PointCloud.FlashStep
entries.help: Largest rise of the scan layer's mean linear luminance (0..1 of the screen at full white) allowed per r.PointCloud.FlashRiseSeconds

entries.name: r.PointCloud.GpuStore
entries.help: Keep the persistent scan cloud in a GPU hash table (insert, dedup and scan-memory fade on the GPU, drawn by the compute rasteriser) instead of the CPU accumulator chunks; needs 64-bit buffer atomics. A save reads the store back and writes it with the CPU chunks. Off by default

entries.name: r.PointCloud.GpuStoreCull
entries.help: GPU point store: compact the live, in-view slots and rasterise only those through an indirect launch, instead of walking every slot of the table. 0 = walk the whole table.

entries.name: r.PointCloud.GrowSplats
entries.help: Grow Gaussian splats from the accumulated scan on every point cloud (project option, off by default); a cloud's own Grow Splats turns them on for that cloud alone

entries.name: r.PointCloud.HoleFill
entries.help: Fill a scan-layer pixel no splat covered when its neighbours on opposite sides were covered on two axes (a gap inside a surface, never its outline)

entries.name: r.PointCloud.LodDistance
entries.help: Compute rasteriser LOD: past this view distance (m) a page keeps only the (distance ratio)^2 prefix of its rank-ordered points; 0 keeps every point

entries.name: r.PointCloud.LodMinFraction
entries.help: Compute rasteriser LOD: the smallest share of a page's points kept at any distance (0.01..1)

entries.name: r.PointCloud.MaxPointSize
entries.help: Largest splat diameter in output pixels whatever the component asks for; the scan's photosensitivity ceiling

entries.name: r.PointCloud.Palette
entries.help: Scan palette: 0 authored, 1 red-green safe, 2 blue-yellow safe, 3 monochrome with a splat shape per material family

entries.name: r.PointCloud.SizeScale
entries.help: Player scale on every splat's size, 0.75..2; still capped by r.PointCloud.MaxPointSize

entries.name: r.PointCloud.Splats
entries.help: Draw the Gaussian splats grown from scans on clouds with Grow Splats on: 0 = points only

entries.name: r.PointCloud.Splats.Max
entries.help: Most splats one cloud draws a frame (the nearest are kept); the back-to-front sort runs on the CPU each frame

entries.name: r.PointCloud.StreamMode
entries.help: Streamer mode: splats x1.75, density x0.75, no shrink-on-fade, and half the flash limiter's rise step, so a compressed video stream keeps the scan readable

entries.name: r.PostProcessMaterial
entries.help: Path of a PostProcess-domain .mat material evaluated as a fullscreen pass after tonemapping (empty = the scene/volume setting).

entries.name: r.PreExposure
entries.help: Pre-expose scene color: HDR targets store radiance scaled by the previous frame's exposure (clamped), tonemap divides it back out — keeps RGBA16F in range when physical light intensities (a 100k-lux sun) exist: 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.PSOCache.Prewarm
entries.help: Prewarm pipelines from the bundled PSO cache at game startup (populates the driver and backend pipeline caches before the first frame)

entries.name: r.PSOCache.Record
entries.help: Record created pipelines into <project>/Saved/PsoCache/PsoCache.mdfb: -1=auto (project open, non-shipping), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.PSOPrecache.AsyncGraph
entries.help: Compile material-graph pipelines on job workers: 1 = the draw keeps the material's uber (fallback) pipeline until its own PSO is built, 0 = compile synchronously on first use (the old first-sight hitch)

entries.name: r.Quality
entries.help: Scalability preset: -1=code default, 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High, 3=Epic, 4=Cinematic (flips the render-feature Options bundle + the FScalabilityTiers numeric row)

entries.name: r.RayTracing.EnableForProject
entries.help: Project switch: 1 = this project uses hardware ray tracing (RT reflections, RT shadows, RTAO, the HWRT GI gather, the path tracer, DLSS Ray Reconstruction). 0 = no TLAS is built and no RT pipeline compiles

entries.name: r.RDG.AsyncCompute
entries.help: Global async-compute switch: 0 = everything inline; 1 = passes and features that opt in (r.GI.AsyncCompute, ...) run on the async-compute lane where the backend has a real second queue (D3D12, Vulkan), forked as early and joined as late as their dependencies allow, and never beside an ALU-heavy pass; 2 = additionally force every compute-shaped graph pass onto the lane (testing; read when a graph compiles). D3D11 and Metal-without-lane record inline whatever this says

entries.name: r.RDG.BatchBarriers
entries.help: Issue each render-graph pass's image transitions as one barrier call (D3D12 one ResourceBarrier, Vulkan one vkCmdPipelineBarrier2, split where an image repeats) instead of one call per resource: 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.RDG.PlacedAliasing
entries.help: Back render-graph transients with placed images packed into shared heaps, so resources of different formats and sizes with disjoint lifetimes share memory (D3D12 and Vulkan; other backends keep the exact-match alias groups): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.RDG.PostChain
entries.help: Record the head and tail of the post chain on the frame graph: the reactive masks, the temporal upscaler hand-off, the post-process material and the Final blit, with their barriers derived from declared reads and writes. 0 = the old path, each pass outside the graph with hand-placed transitions. Takes effect at the next graph rebuild

entries.name: r.RDG.SplitBarriers
entries.help: Split render-graph transitions of transients: begin right after the last pass that used the resource, end right before the next, so the GPU retires the transition behind the passes in between (D3D12 BEGIN_ONLY/END_ONLY, Vulkan events; other backends issue the whole transition at the end): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.RDG.TransientViewTargets
entries.help: Allocate the frame-local post targets (depth-of-field CoC, motion-blur velocity and tile maps, the bloom chain and, with r.RDG.PostChain, the reactive-mask pair) as frame-graph transients that alias with other scratch of the same shape, instead of persistent per-view images. 0 = persistent images imported into the graph. Takes effect at the next graph rebuild

entries.name: r.ReflectionProbes.Bake
entries.help: Bake captured reflection probes to the DerivedDataCache and reload them on scene open instead of re-capturing (mbt cook packages them so shipped games skip runtime capture). 1=on (default), 0=always capture at runtime

entries.name: r.Reflections.Continuation
entries.help: Screen-trace-first reflections: 1=one ray per pixel — screen march, then the SAME ray continues into the SDF/RT world trace where the screen leg is inconclusive (default), 0=legacy independent traces blended by confidence (A/B)

entries.name: r.Reflections.MirrorReproject
entries.help: Roughness ceiling for mirrored-point temporal reprojection: at or below it a screen-leg hit fetches its reflection history from where the REFLECTED point was last frame instead of where the surface was, which is what the reflected image actually tracks. OFF by default: the history's depth/normal validity is keyed to the SURFACE, so a mirrored colour fetch is validated against the wrong pixel, accumulation never converges and the per-frame trace noise shows through as speckle — worse than the lag it removes. Keyed validity needs a reflection hit-distance channel in the moments history. 0 = surface reprojection only

entries.name: r.Reflections.Translucent
entries.help: One-ray reflections on forward translucent surfaces (High/Epic, SDF radiance cache + sky miss; reflective materials only): 0=off (env/none), 1=on

entries.name: r.Reflections.WorldLegConfidence
entries.help: Confidence the SDF world leg reports at mirror roughness, relative to the screen leg (ramps to 1 at the roughness cutoff). The world leg returns cell-quantised cache radiance where the screen leg returns real scene colour; below 1 the resolve leans back on env specular across the handover instead of cutting to a blurrier source at full strength. 1 = legacy equal confidence

entries.name: r.Renderer.DeferredRelease
entries.help: Create, destroy and resize scene views, resize the primary view's output and reallocate the volumetric fog grid and cloud targets without draining the GPU: what they drop goes through the backends' deferred-delete queues (or SubmitDeferredRelease) once the frames that read it have retired. 1=on, 0=WaitIdle first (A/B)

entries.name: r.RenderScale
entries.help: Internal render resolution scale (0.25..1.0): -1=tier value (upscaler policy may also drive it)

entries.name: r.RT.BLASCompaction
entries.help: Copy each freshly built BLAS into a right-sized allocation using the driver's post-build compacted size: 0=off 1=on

entries.name: r.RT.BLASCompaction.Budget
entries.help: Maximum BLAS compaction copies per frame — each is a separate GPU submit, so this is what keeps a build burst from hitching

entries.name: r.RT.BLASCompaction.MinSaving
entries.help: Skip the copy when the compacted structure would reclaim less than this percentage of the built size

entries.name: r.RT.Foliage
entries.help: Put GPU-instanced foliage clumps near the camera in the scene TLAS (one instance per clump, sharing the clump mesh's BLAS), so RT shadows, reflections, AO and the hardware GI gather see grass: 0 = leave it out, 1 = include

entries.name: r.RT.Foliage.Distance
entries.help: World radius around the camera inside which foliage clumps join the TLAS

entries.name: r.RT.Foliage.MaxInstances
entries.help: Most foliage clumps placed in the TLAS per frame

entries.name: r.RT.InFrameBuilds
entries.help: Record BLAS/TLAS builds made while a frame records into that frame's command list instead of a single-time submit and fence wait: 1=on (those builds are not compacted), 0=synchronous builds with compaction

entries.name: r.RT.Terrain
entries.help: Put CDLOD terrain in the scene TLAS as tiles of real triangles generated from the height texture (up to 256 quads a side, one updatable BLAS per 64x64 tile, refit where a sculpt touched): 0 = leave it out, so RT shadows, reflections, AO and the hardware GI gather see no ground, 1 = include

entries.name: r.RT.Translucent
entries.help: Put alpha-blended geometry in the scene TLAS, masked so only reflection rays (and shadow rays under r.RT.TranslucentShadows) see it, accepted stochastically by its opacity: 0 = leave it out (the old behaviour), 1 = include

entries.name: r.RT.TranslucentShadows
entries.help: Alpha-blended shadow casters occlude ray-traced shadow rays by their opacity (needs r.RT.Translucent): 0 = off, 1 = on

entries.name: r.RTAO
entries.help: Hardware ray-traced ambient occlusion instead of GTAO (needs ray query; implies the ray scene): -1=tier value, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.RTAO.Calibration
entries.help: Gain applied to ray-traced occlusion so its mean matches the screen-space integrator this pass replaces behind the AO slot. GTAO's raised horizon blocks the whole arc beneath it where a ray counts only geometry it meets, so a true trace reports less; the art is tuned on GTAO, and a gain moves the mean at constant signal-to-noise where a longer ray would not. Fitted on the gi-spatial-noise scene; 1 = raw traced occlusion

entries.name: r.RTAO.Radius
entries.help: World-space occlusion ray length for RTAO, overriding the shared ssaoRadius setting (-1 = that setting times r.RTAO.RadiusScale). The two implementations behind the AO slot read that scalar differently — GTAO as a screen march it clamps to a 3-pixel floor, RTAO as a hard world TMax — so the shared 0.5 default is a real half-metre ray here and occludes a twentieth of what GTAO does; the fitted scale puts the two within a twentieth of each other and this knob overrides the product outright

entries.name: r.RTAO.RadiusScale
entries.help: What the shared ssaoRadius setting is multiplied by before RTAO uses it as a world-space ray length. It exists because the two integrators behind the AO slot read that scalar differently, so the tier boundary that swaps them would otherwise change scene brightness. Reach buys mean occlusion at a steep price in variance — two stochastic rays a pixel cannot support a long one — so this stays short enough for gi-static-flicker and r.RTAO.Calibration closes the rest. r.RTAO.Radius overrides the product outright

entries.name: r.RTAO.Rays
entries.help: RT AO occlusion rays per pixel: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.RTAO.TemporalAlpha
entries.help: History weight of the RTAO temporal accumulation on a still pixel (0.96 = ~25 frames). Two rays a frame need far more than the ten frames 0.9 gave them, and the short window was what left blurred noise crawling on a still camera: widening it took the crawling-pixel count at Epic from 4.89% to 3.09% and at Cinematic from 5.95% to 2.11%, which is the headroom the AO calibration gain spends. Safe by construction because motion still opens the weight toward 0.5 and depth rejection still drops a disoccluded history, so only a STILL pixel integrates this long

entries.name: r.RTAO.TemporalClamp
entries.help: Width of the RTAO history clamp box as a multiple of the shared default. The box is centred on THIS frame's two-ray AO, whose centre jumps about as far as the box is wide, so the default clamp drags the history to a new edge every frame and the average never forms

entries.name: r.RTReflections
entries.help: Hardware ray-traced reflections through the scene TLAS instead of the SSR ray march (needs ray query; implies the ray scene): -1=tier value, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.RTReflections.HitLighting
entries.help: RT reflection hit shading: 0=flat per-instance records (legacy), 1=GI radiance cache with near-hit blend toward the records (default; falls back to the records where the cache is absent/unbaked), 2=pure cache (A/B, no near blend)

entries.name: r.RTReflections.Pipeline
entries.help: Trace the RT reflection world leg through a real ray-tracing pipeline (raygen + miss + a per-material closest-hit table) instead of the inline ray query: 1=on where the backend and device allow it, 0=inline pass (default). Read once when the post graph is built, because the pass it adds changes the trace target's usage flags. Off by default while the legacy-blend interaction below is open — see mowoengine.com/docs/rendering/ray-tracing/

entries.name: r.RTReflections.RoughnessCutoff
entries.help: RT reflections roughness cutoff — rougher surfaces fall back to SDF/env: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.RTReflections.SecondBounce
entries.help: Let a smooth metallic reflection HIT trace one more reflection ray, shaded by whatever material that ray lands on (pipeline path only — an inline query cannot recurse). 1=on (default), 0=one bounce

entries.name: r.RTScene
entries.help: Maintain BLAS/TLAS over static scene geometry for ray-traced passes: 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.RTScene.BlasBudget
entries.help: New BLAS builds per frame (each is a synchronous single-time submit) — residency amortizes across frames, the resident set itself is unbounded

entries.name: r.RTShadows
entries.help: Ray-traced sun shadows through the scene TLAS on top of CSM/VSM (implies r.RTScene): -1=scalability tier (Cinematic), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.RTShadows.Samples
entries.help: RT sun shadow cone samples per pixel (jittered in the sun disc, temporally accumulated): -1=tier value, else 1..8

entries.name: r.RTShadows.Spatial
entries.help: Depth-aware separable blur over the temporally accumulated RT sun shadow before the lighting reads it: 1 = on, 0 = the accumulation alone

entries.name: r.Shadow.BlockerSamples
entries.help: PCSS blocker-search taps per pixel: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Shadow.Cascades
entries.help: Directional shadow cascades rendered (1..4): -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Shadow.CsmStaticCache
entries.help: Static CSM cache: 1 = each cascade keeps its static casters in a second atlas and re-renders them only when the cascade's matrix or a static caster it reaches changes; a frame restores the cascade from it and draws only skinned, moving and WPO casters, terrain and foliage. 0 = every caster every frame

entries.name: r.Shadow.CsmStaticCache.MaxRestoreFraction
entries.help: A cached cascade whose restore and dynamic layer both cover more than this fraction of its tile (terrain, foliage, a skinned crowd) draws every caster into its own cleared tile instead and keeps the cache for later: a full-tile depth copy from the pixel shader costs more GPU time than the static casters it saves, which is why UE caches only cascades movables do not cover

entries.name: r.Shadow.CsmStaticCache.Scroll
entries.help: Static CSM cache while the camera moves: 1 = a cascade the camera slid by whole texels restores its cached static layer at that offset and draws only the static casters of the uncovered strips (re-anchoring past an eighth of the tile); 0 = a moving cascade redraws every caster

entries.name: r.Shadow.CsmStaticCache.Scroll.MinCascade
entries.help: First cascade a sliding camera scrolls instead of redrawing. A scroll is a full-tile shifted depth copy from the pixel shader; on the near cascades, which slide almost every frame of a moving camera, it cost more GPU time than the static casters it saved (csm-static-cache: 1.74 against 0.40 ms of Shadow scope), so they redraw and only the far cascades scroll

entries.name: r.Shadow.FilterSamples
entries.help: PCSS penumbra filter taps per pixel: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Shadow.Local.Virtual
entries.help: Local-light shadows as paged virtual shadow maps: 1 = every shadow view a sparse map of up to r.Shadow.Local.VirtualMaxPages^2 pages of 128 texels, only the pages the camera can reach resident in the atlas and kept across frames until their light or casters change; 0 = one packed atlas tile per view; -1 = the scalability tier (High and up page, Medium and below use the atlas)

entries.name: r.Shadow.Local.Virtual.DepthMarks
entries.help: Local virtual shadow pages are mapped only where a visible receiver in the scene depth projects into them (read back a few frames late; while the camera or a light moves the camera-frustum reach decides): 1 = on, 0 = every page the camera frustum can reach

entries.name: r.Shadow.Local.Virtual.MarkStride
entries.help: Screen-pixel stride of the local virtual shadow depth-marking pass (1-16); a page is 128 shadow texels, so a coarse stride still finds every receiver of any size that matters

entries.name: r.Shadow.Local.Virtual.TwoLayer
entries.help: Two-layer local virtual shadow pages: 1 = a second atlas keeps each resident page's static depth, so a page under a moving dynamic caster (skinned mesh, moving body, animated foliage) copies its static depth back and redraws only the dynamic casters; 0 = such a page redraws every caster under it

entries.name: r.Shadow.Local.VirtualMaxPages
entries.help: Pages per side of the largest local virtual shadow map (16 = 2048 texels); when the visible pages outgrow the atlas the largest maps give up a level first

entries.name: r.Shadow.LocalCache
entries.help: Cached local shadow-atlas tiles: 1=re-render only tiles whose light or intersecting caster set changed (static tiles cost zero draws), 0=legacy full atlas clear + re-render every frame

entries.name: r.Shadow.LocalMinTile
entries.help: Smallest local shadow atlas tile in px (a light that cannot get one goes unshadowed): -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Shadow.LocalTileSize
entries.help: Largest local shadow atlas tile in px (the most important light gets one): -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Shadow.MaxDistance
entries.help: Directional (CSM) shadow range in world units; the sun shadow fades to unshadowed over the last 15% of it. A scene's World Settings shadow max distance (> 0) overrides this

entries.name: r.Shadow.MaxLocalViews
entries.help: Local shadow atlas view budget (1 view per shadowed spot/rect, 6 per point): -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Shadow.MaxPenumbraTexels
entries.help: PCSS penumbra ceiling in shadow-map texels: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.Shadow.Resolution
entries.help: CSM per-cascade shadow tile resolution (atlas = 2x2 of this): -1=tier value, else 256..8192 (live atlas recreate)

entries.name: r.Shadow.SdfFar
entries.help: SDF far sun shadows: past r.Shadow.MaxDistance the sun cone-traces the GI global SDF for soft distant occlusion instead of going unshadowed (needs the SDF, Medium+): -1=tier value, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.Shadow.SdfFarSteps
entries.help: SDF far sun shadow trace step cap: -1=tier value, else 8..128

entries.name: r.Shadow.Soft
entries.help: Soft shadows: 0=fixed PCF kernel, 1=PCSS (blocker search + variable-radius filter, penumbra from the light's source size): -1=tier value (High+)

entries.name: r.Shadow.StableFit
entries.help: CSM cascade fit: 1=constant-radius world-sphere extent + texel-snapped ortho origin (world-locked, no edge crawl under camera motion), 0=legacy tight per-frame light-space AABB with no snap (extent pumps + grid crawls = shadow-edge swim)

entries.name: r.Shadow.Translucent
entries.help: Alpha-blended meshes with Cast Shadows cast a partial shadow into the cascades and the local atlas: each texel is kept with the material's opacity as its probability (dithered, then softened by the shadow filter), so a 30%-opaque pane casts a 30% shadow instead of none or a black one. 0 = translucent meshes cast no raster shadow

entries.name: r.Sharpness
entries.help: Post-AA CAS sharpening override in percent: -1=scene setting, 0=off, 1-100=strength

entries.name: r.Sky.CoupleAmbient
entries.help: L3 sky<->ambient coupling: 1=the GI probe-miss sky is derived from the sky actually on screen, 0=legacy flat ambientColor*ambientIntensity (the pre-fix 4-17x mismatch — A/B only)

entries.name: r.Sky.MoonIntensity
entries.help: Moon disc intensity at night (0 = off); rides anti-sun with a crescent phase from the sun/moon geometry

entries.name: r.Sky.Rotation
entries.help: Degrees of extra sky yaw about world up, ADDED to the sky light's authored Sky Rotation. Turns the cubemap sky and every lobe derived from it (irradiance, prefilter, forward sky miss, reflection captures) together; a procedural atmosphere ignores it

entries.name: r.Sky.Stars
entries.help: Procedural star field intensity at night (0 = off); fades in below the horizon, fully visible once the sun is 12 degrees under

entries.name: r.SkyAtmosphere.AerialPerspective
entries.help: Tint distant geometry with the atmosphere's in-scattering and transmittance (the froxel volume the sky LUTs feed): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.SkyAtmosphere.Translucency
entries.help: Sky atmosphere on translucents and particles: 1=they take the aerial perspective and height fog the atmosphere composite gives the opaque pixel behind them (default), 0=none (A/B)

entries.name: r.SkyIBL.CrossfadeSeconds
entries.help: Crossfade between sky-IBL generations when the time-of-day rebake fires: seconds to blend the previous irradiance/prefilter into the new one, 0 = discrete swap (old behavior)

entries.name: r.SkyLight.CaptureClouds
entries.help: Include the cloud layer in the sky light capture, so clouds shade the ambient and appear in reflections: 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.SkyLight.CaptureSize
entries.help: Face size of the sky light capture cubemap the irradiance and reflection maps are convolved from (32..512)

entries.name: r.SkyLight.CloudRecaptureSeconds
entries.help: Shortest time between real-time sky light captures that only drifting clouds asked for (the sun, intensity or atmosphere changing still re-captures on the sky light's interval); the IBL crossfades between captures

entries.name: r.SSGI
entries.help: Screen-space one-bounce indirect diffuse: -1=tier value, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.SSGI.Rays
entries.help: SSGI hemisphere rays per pixel: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.SSGI.Steps
entries.help: SSGI depth-march steps per ray: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.SSR
entries.help: Screen-space reflections (the whole trace/temporal/resolve slice): -1=tier value (Medium+ on, Low hard-off), 0=off, 1=on. Scene PostFX settings act within this.

entries.name: r.SSR.FilterTaps
entries.help: Reflection spatial filter kernel: 5 = 5x5 taps, 3 = 3x3 a-trous over the same footprint (a third of the cost)

entries.name: r.SSR.MaxSteps
entries.help: Cap on the scene's SSR raymarch step count: -1=tier value, 0=uncapped

entries.name: r.SSR.TraceDivisor
entries.help: Resolution divisor of the screen-leg reflection trace: -1=tier value, 1=full res, 2=half (a quarter of the pixels traced per frame, rotating over a 2x2 block; SSRUpsample rebuilds the rest and the temporal pass integrates them)

entries.name: r.SSS.Width
entries.help: Subsurface blur radius in pixels at full strength (the profile shapes the falloff inside it)

entries.name: r.Substrate
entries.help: Substrate layered-BSDF slabs on compiled material graphs: 0=off (the Output node's Substrate slot is ignored and every graph emits byte-identical source), 1=on (a slab compiles into the two-slab G-Buffer encode). Materials must be recompiled after changing this.

entries.name: r.Terrain.CDLOD
entries.help: Terrain render path: 1=CDLOD (quadtree-selected instanced patches displaced by a height texture, continuous morph LOD), 0=legacy per-chunk meshes with discrete LOD chains

entries.name: r.Terrain.ErrorPixels
entries.help: CDLOD terrain screen-space error tolerance in pixels — lower = denser node selection (more draws, finer far detail)

entries.name: r.Terrain.MorphZone
entries.help: Fraction of each CDLOD node's range spent morphing to the coarser grid (0.05-0.95)

entries.name: r.Terrain.RVT
entries.help: Terrain runtime virtual texture — bake the splat blend into feedback-streamed VT pages and sample the composite per pixel: -1=tier value (High+ on), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.Terrain.RVTVirtualPages
entries.help: Terrain RVT virtual size in 128-texel pages per axis (64 = 8192 virtual texels across the terrain); applies to caches created after the change

entries.name: r.Terrain.Wireframe
entries.help: Draw CDLOD terrain with a wireframe fill pipeline (shows the live LOD density): 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.Texture.KeepCpuCopy
entries.help: Keep every texture's decoded / cooked CPU pixels after the GPU upload: 0 = free them (a texture that needs them opts in with TextureAsset::SetKeepCpuCopy), 1 = keep all (A/B)

entries.name: r.TextureStreaming
entries.help: Camera-driven texture mip streaming (1 = on). Off keeps every scene texture fully resident.

entries.name: r.TextureStreaming.MaxUploadBytesPerFrame
entries.help: Byte budget for texture mip uploads SUBMITTED per frame (the disk portion; GPU-copied resident tails are free). Uploads are asynchronous — the visible swap lands when the GPU finishes — so this bounds per-frame transfer bandwidth, not a stall. <= 0 = unbounded.

entries.name: r.TextureStreaming.PoolSizeMB
entries.help: Streaming texture residency budget in MB (0 = unlimited). The farthest textures coarsen first when the desired set exceeds it.

entries.name: r.TextureStreaming.VramPressure
entries.help: Shrink the texture and mesh LOD streaming pools (splitting the overshoot by what each holds) while the driver reports device-local usage over 95% of the VRAM budget the OS grants (relaxes under 85%): 1 = on, 0 = the configured pool only.

entries.name: r.Tonemap
entries.help: Tonemap operator override: -1=scene setting, 0=ACES (fit), 1=AgX, 2=Reinhard, 3=clamp, 4=ACES RRT+ODT (sRGB 100-nit ODT, 1000-nit under HDR output), 5=display LUT (r.DisplayLUT / the scene's; ACES RRT+ODT while none)

entries.name: r.TSR.AntiFlicker
entries.help: TSR anti-flicker: damping applied to the current frame where its raw luma oscillates beyond the variance box between frames (0 = off)

entries.name: r.TSR.ClampGamma
entries.help: TSR history rectification: width of the YCoCg variance box in standard deviations (lower = less ghosting, more flicker; < 0 disables clipping)

entries.name: r.TSR.Debug
entries.help: TSR debug view written in place of the resolved image: 0 = off, 1 = history weight (sample count / MaxSamples), 2 = rejection (R = depth/off-screen reject, G = clip amount, B = reactive mask), 3 = velocity (RG = signed output pixels/frame, B = velocity clamp ramp)

entries.name: r.TSR.MaxSamples
entries.help: TSR temporal accumulation cap — the per-pixel sample count saturates here (alpha floor = 1/N)

entries.name: r.TSR.Sharpness
entries.help: TSR output sharpening (RCAS lobe): 0 = off, 1 = full

entries.name: r.TSR.Velocity.WeightClampingPixelSpeed
entries.help: TSR: output-pixel speed per frame at which the history clamp reaches WeightClampingSampleCount

entries.name: r.TSR.Velocity.WeightClampingSampleCount
entries.help: TSR: sample count the history is clamped to at r.TSR.Velocity.WeightClampingPixelSpeed (lower = crisper motion, more flicker; >= MaxSamples disables)

entries.name: r.Upscale.ReactiveMask
entries.help: Derive a reactive mask from the pre/post-translucency scene diff and feed it to the temporal upscaler (0 = off)

entries.name: r.Upscaler
entries.help: Active upscaler: -1=auto (picked from the device at startup), 0=None 1=TAA 2=Spatial 3=FSR 4=DLSS 5=TSR 6=XeSS 7=MetalFX (runtime-toggleable). ApplyUpscalerCVars ignores -1, so the auto slot never overrides the renderer before FQualityAutoTier fills it.

entries.name: r.Upscaler.DeferredRelease
entries.help: Reallocate upscaler history and intermediates (TSR, FSR 1, the FSR 3 context) on a resize without draining the GPU: the old images and contexts are released once the frames that read them have retired. 1=on, 0=WaitIdle first (A/B)

entries.name: r.UpscalerQuality
entries.help: Upscaler quality: 0=Native(DLAA) 1=Quality 2=Balanced 3=Performance 4=Ultra

entries.name: r.VdbVolumes
entries.help: Ray-march VDB volumes (VdbVolume components): 0 = off, 1 = on

entries.name: r.VdbVolumes.ShadowSteps
entries.help: Samples of the self-shadow march toward the sun at each view sample; 0 = unshadowed

entries.name: r.VdbVolumes.Steps
entries.help: View-ray samples through each VDB volume's box

entries.name: r.Velocity.MoversOnly
entries.help: Velocity pass: 1 = a fullscreen compose writes every pixel's camera-motion velocity from the GBuffer depth and only movers (skinned, WPO, transform changed since last frame) are rasterised on top; 0 = redraw the whole opaque list (the pre-2026-09-28 pass, A/B)

entries.name: r.ViewDistanceScale
entries.help: Global multiplier on every object's authored maxDrawDistance at cull time: -1=tier value

entries.name: r.ViewMode
entries.help: Debug buffer view: -1=host decides (editor View menu), 0=Shaded, 1=Wireframe, 2=Unlit, 3=Normals, 4=Depth, 5=Roughness, 6=Metallic, 7=BaseColor, 8=Emissive, 9=AmbientOcclusion, 10=ShadowCascades, 11=DetailLighting, 12=LightingOnly, 13=Velocity, 14=GlobalIllumination, 15=Reflections, 16=PathTracing

entries.name: r.VirtualTexture
entries.help: Virtual texturing — feedback-driven page streaming over a GPU page table + physical atlas, driving a virtual-textured ground surface: -1=off (default), 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.VirtualTexture.Source
entries.help: VFS path of a cooked virtual-texture tile file (<texture>.mvtiles, the Virtual Texture Tiles import setting) the ground surface streams BCn pages from; empty = the procedural source

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds
entries.help: Cloud rendering master switch: -1=code default, 0=off, 1=on. r.VolumetricClouds.Mode picks the implementation

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.BaseAltitude
entries.help: Bottom of the raymarched cloud layer, in absolute world units

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Coverage
entries.help: Cloud coverage fraction (0 = clear sky, 1 = overcast)

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Density
entries.help: Raymarched cloud extinction per world unit at full coverage

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Detail
entries.help: Silhouette erosion strength from the detail noise volume (0 = smooth blobs)

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.EnableForProject
entries.help: Project switch: 1 = this project may raymarch the volumetric cloud volume. 0 = a cloud actor draws the flat cloud layer and the cloud noise volumes are never built

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Height
entries.help: Cloud plane height in world units above the camera

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Intensity
entries.help: Multiplier on the composited cloud radiance

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.LightSteps
entries.help: Sun light-march taps per lit sample: -1 = scalability tier default

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.MaxDistance
entries.help: Longest raymarch segment through the cloud layer, in world units

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Mode
entries.help: Cloud implementation: -1=scalability tier default, 1=2.5D fbm sky plane (cheap), 2=raymarched volume (Epic+, flyable)

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Powder
entries.help: Powder-term strength on the sun transmittance (dark edges on lit cloud tops)

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Resolution
entries.help: Raymarch target resolution divisor (1 = full res, 2 = half, 4 = quarter)

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Scale
entries.help: Raymarched cloud noise frequency (1 / world units per shape-volume tile)

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Steps
entries.help: Raymarch step budget (upper bound of the adaptive count): -1 = scalability tier default

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Temporal
entries.help: Temporal reprojection blend for the raymarch (0 = no history, 0.95 = heavy)

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.TopAltitude
entries.help: Top of the raymarched cloud layer, in absolute world units

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.Type
entries.help: Cloud type: 0 = flat stratus sheet, 1 = tall cumulus towers

entries.name: r.VolumetricClouds.WindSpeed
entries.help: Raymarched cloud wind speed in world units per second

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog
entries.help: Froxel volumetric fog (3D light grid: height fog + fog volumes, sun-scattered with per-froxel CSM shadow, temporally reprojected, composited before transparency): -1=code default, 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog.Anisotropy
entries.help: Henyey-Greenstein phase g for the sun in-scatter (>0 = forward, sharper god rays)

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog.EnableForProject
entries.help: Project switch: 1 = this project uses froxel volumetric fog. 0 = height fog stays analytic and the froxel volumes are never built

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog.GiAmbient
entries.help: Froxel fog ambient: 1 = each froxel takes the mean radiance the DDGI probe field gives its position (sealed rooms stay dark, fog by a lit wall picks up its bounce) whenever the field is live, 0 = one constant ambient from the scene's ambient colour everywhere (A/B)

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog.HeightFalloff
entries.help: Exponential height-fog falloff per world unit above the base plane

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog.MaxLocalLights
entries.help: Point/spot lights injected into the froxel fog, nearest-first (0 = sun/ambient only). Per light, LightComponent volumetricScattering scales or disables its contribution

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog.Temporal
entries.help: Temporal reprojection blend for the froxel injection (0 = no history, 0.9 = heavy)

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog.Translucency
entries.help: Froxel fog on translucents: 1=forward transparents (glass, water, the OIT path) take the integrated froxel volume at their own depth, the haze the opaque composite gives the pixel behind them (default), 0=analytic fog only (A/B)

entries.name: r.VRS
entries.help: Variable-rate shading of the G-buffer from a per-tile rate image (D3D12 VRS Tier 2 / Vulkan fragment shading rate): 0 = off, 1 = on. No effect where the device has no image-based VRS

entries.name: r.VRS.ContrastThreshold
entries.help: Mean perceptual luminance step between neighbouring samples of a tile below which it shades coarser along that axis

entries.name: r.VRS.MotionThreshold
entries.help: Screen motion in pixels per frame above which a tile shades at 2x2 whatever its contrast

entries.name: r.VSM
entries.help: Virtual shadow maps: 0=off, 1=on (-1 = scalability tier default, Epic+)

entries.name: r.VSM.CasterRuns
entries.help: VSM caster runs: 1=consecutive static casters on one mesh and LOD draw their dirty pages with one indirect call per run (page lists packed on the GPU), 0=one indirect call per caster

entries.name: r.VSM.Clipmap.FirstExtent
entries.help: Half-extent in world units of the finest VSM clipmap level; each further level doubles it. 96x96 pages of 64 texels over this extent sets the finest texel a receiver can ask for (2 = 0.65 mm); receivers take the coarsest level their pixel footprint still resolves, so a small first level costs pages only where the camera is close enough to use it

entries.name: r.VSM.Clipmap.Levels
entries.help: VSM clipmap level count (1..16); -1 = the fewest levels whose coarsest extent still covers r.Shadow.MaxDistance. Receivers past the coarsest level fall back to the CSM

entries.name: r.VSM.Clipmap.LodBias
entries.help: VSM clipmap level bias against the receiver's pixel footprint: 0 = one shadow texel per screen pixel, -1 = two per pixel (4x the page demand; UE's default sits near -1.5 on a pool four times this one), +1 = half

entries.name: r.VSM.CsmCasters
entries.help: Mesh casters in the CSM cascades while the virtual shadow map is on: -1 = only until the VSM resolved with a steady page cache (no flood, no deferred pages), then the cascades carry terrain and GPU foliage alone and every sun-shadow reader samples the VSM pages; 1 = always draw them (the pre-2026-09-28 double raster, A/B); 0 = never draw them under VSM

entries.name: r.VSM.PageBudget
entries.help: Max VSM pages re-rasterized per frame; stale pages past the budget keep waiting and the CSM serves their pixels, so a sun move or mass invalidation never hitches. Capped at 1024 (the per-frame page list); 0 = that cap

entries.name: r.VSM.SmrtRayLength
entries.help: SMRT occluder search distance toward the sun in world units; 0 = 16

entries.name: r.VSM.SmrtRays
entries.help: Shadow-map ray-tracing rays per pixel in the VSM resolve (jittered across the sun's angular extent)

entries.name: r.VSM.SmrtSamples
entries.help: Depth samples marched along each SMRT ray

entries.name: r.VSM.StableFit
entries.help: VSM camera-decoupled light space: 1=toroidal clipmap scroll (a camera step invalidates the row/column that wrapped in, the rest of the page cache survives), 0=legacy behaviour where any window scroll floods the whole clipmap stale

entries.name: r.VSync
entries.help: Vertical sync. 1 = on, 0 = off, -1 = follow the window config (default).

entries.name: r.Vulkan.AsyncCompute.SyncSubmit
entries.help: 1 = submit the async-compute fork, hand-off and join through FRHIThread::ExecuteSync (the render thread waits for the whole RHI queue each time), 0 = enqueue the submit and keep recording

entries.name: r.Vulkan.AsyncUploads
entries.help: Create-with-data uploads on Vulkan (static buffers, texture data, IBL bakes, upload batches) submit their single-time command buffer and return without waiting for the GPU; the staging is released once the submit's fence signals. 0 = wait for every upload (the old blocking path)

entries.name: r.Vulkan.PipelineReuse
entries.help: Share one VkPipeline between pipelines created from an identical spec (shader content + full state hash): 0=every creation compiles its own, 1=dedupe

entries.name: r.Vulkan.ValidationRepeat
entries.help: Log every occurrence of a validation message instead of only the first: 0=dedupe, 1=repeat

entries.name: r.WarmPipelinesOnStartup
entries.help: Pre-compile the lazy feature pipeline groups (MegaLights/fog/clouds/screen probes/path trace/VT/...) at startup so first feature use never hitches on a PSO compile: 0=off, 1=on

entries.name: r.Water.Caustics
entries.help: Underwater caustics: an animated cellular light pattern projected onto submerged geometry, faded by the water column above it. Needs the water info texture for the surface height.

entries.name: r.Water.CausticStrength
entries.help: Brightness of the underwater caustic pattern.

entries.name: r.Water.Foam
entries.help: Water foam: shore band where water meets geometry + Gerstner crest foam.

entries.name: r.Water.InfoResolution
entries.help: Water info texture resolution per side (clamped 32-1024). Higher resolves a narrower river channel; the raster is CPU-side and only re-runs when a body changes.

entries.name: r.Water.InfoTexture
entries.help: Water info texture: a top-down raster of depth-to-bottom, flow and surface height over every water body, read by the water shader for bathymetric colour, shoreline foam and flow-advected foam UVs. 0 = the pre-texture look, pixel for pixel.

entries.name: r.Water.Reflections
entries.help: Fresnel-weighted environment reflection on water surfaces, sharing the translucent reflection ray (needs r.Reflections.Translucent and a built SDF radiance cache).

entries.name: r.Water.Refraction
entries.help: Water refraction: sample the opaque scene color behind the surface with a normal-perturbed, depth-scaled offset. Latched at renderer init (selects the WATER+REFRACTION shader variant).

entries.name: r.Water.Underwater
entries.help: Fullscreen tint + distance fog when the camera is below a water surface.

entries.name: r.Water.Wetness
entries.help: Shoreline wetness: geometry in a band just above the waterline is darkened and smoothed in the deferred lighting pass, so its specular sharpens as well. Needs the water info texture for the per-pixel waterline.

entries.name: r.Water.WetnessBand
entries.help: Metres above the waterline the shoreline wetness band reaches.

entries.name: r.Water.WetnessStrength
entries.help: How wet the shoreline band gets at the waterline: 0 disables the lane, 1 is a fully soaked surface.

entries.name: r.Wind.Flutter
entries.help: High-frequency tip/edge flutter amount, weighted by the vertex-color bend mask

entries.name: r.Wind.Gust
entries.help: Gust amount — 2-octave time noise modulating the sway amplitude (0 = steady wind)

entries.name: r.Wind.Speed
entries.help: Global wind speed multiplier on top of per-foliage windSpeed

entries.name: r.Wind.Strength
entries.help: Global wind strength multiplier on top of per-foliage windStrength

entries.name: r.WorldGrid
entries.help: Procedural world grid on grid materials and on every mesh with no material. 0=flat base colour (a material-less mesh then reads as the old flat grey), 1=grid

entries.name: save.AutosaveInterval
entries.help: Seconds between runtime autosaves into the dedicated autosave slot (0 = off)

entries.name: save.AutosaveOnTravel
entries.help: Flush the outgoing scene's world state into the autosave slot before a map travel, so returning later via load restores it (0 = off)

entries.name: sg.AntiAliasingQuality
entries.help: Scalability group override: -1 = follow r.Quality, 0=Low 1=Medium 2=High 3=Epic 4=Cinematic

entries.name: sg.EffectsQuality
entries.help: Scalability group override: -1 = follow r.Quality, 0=Low 1=Medium 2=High 3=Epic 4=Cinematic

entries.name: sg.FoliageQuality
entries.help: Scalability group override: -1 = follow r.Quality, 0=Low 1=Medium 2=High 3=Epic 4=Cinematic

entries.name: sg.GlobalIlluminationQuality
entries.help: Scalability group override: -1 = follow r.Quality, 0=Low 1=Medium 2=High 3=Epic 4=Cinematic

entries.name: sg.PostProcessQuality
entries.help: Scalability group override: -1 = follow r.Quality, 0=Low 1=Medium 2=High 3=Epic 4=Cinematic

entries.name: sg.ReflectionQuality
entries.help: Scalability group override: -1 = follow r.Quality, 0=Low 1=Medium 2=High 3=Epic 4=Cinematic

entries.name: sg.ShadowQuality
entries.help: Scalability group override: -1 = follow r.Quality, 0=Low 1=Medium 2=High 3=Epic 4=Cinematic

entries.name: sg.TextureQuality
entries.help: Scalability group override: -1 = follow r.Quality, 0=Low 1=Medium 2=High 3=Epic 4=Cinematic

entries.name: sg.ViewDistanceQuality
entries.help: Scalability group override: -1 = follow r.Quality, 0=Low 1=Medium 2=High 3=Epic 4=Cinematic

entries.name: stat
entries.help: stat <none|fps|unit|gpu|memory|hitches|list|dump|enable|disable|startfile|stopfile|group>

entries.name: stat.fps
entries.help: Toggle the FPS overlay in the editor / game view.

entries.name: stat.FrameStats
entries.help: Headless frame-stage profiler dump. 0 = off (default); N > 0 enables the in-process profiler and logs averaged CPU stage times plus the resolved GPU frame total to the log every N frames.

entries.name: stat.FrameStatsCount
entries.help: How many scopes stat.FrameStats lists, ranked by total time. The default of 10 hid the whole gameplay breakdown behind the render stages.

entries.name: stat.FrameStatsFilter
entries.help: Case-insensitive substring; when set, stat.FrameStats lists only scopes whose name contains it (e.g. `System` for the ECS breakdown).

entries.name: t.BatterySaverFPS
entries.help: Frame rate cap while running on battery power. 0 = off (default). M2.5: on phones a card game at 30/60 stretches battery dramatically; high-refresh panels (ProMotion / 120 Hz Android) fall back to this only while unplugged and return to full rate on charger.

entries.name: t.HitchLogMs
entries.help: Log [Hitch] with the frame's phases for any frame longer than this many milliseconds but under t.StallLogMs, at most once a second. 0 = off.

entries.name: t.MaxFPS
entries.help: Frame rate cap. 0 = uncapped (default).

entries.name: t.StallLogMs
entries.help: Log [Stall] with the phases of any frame whose own work (pacing excluded) runs longer than this many milliseconds; with the profiler on, its slowest scopes too. 0 = off.

entries.name: ui.HighContrast
entries.help: Accessibility: draw Arc menus and HUD in the high-contrast theme

entries.name: ui.ReducedMotion
entries.help: Accessibility: skip Arc's decorative transitions and motion

entries.name: vfs.DumpMounts
entries.help: vfs.DumpMounts — log the mount table in resolution order and the read-cache occupancy

entries.name: vfs.LogMisses
entries.help: Log every failed VFS Open with the path and the mounts that were tried

entries.name: vfs.PackagedLooseFiles
entries.help: A packaged run with content paks: 1 keeps the working directory mounted as the lowest-priority VFS fallback, 0 reads relative keys only from the paks (release and profile default) so a loose file beside the package can never stand in for content the cook missed. Absolute paths always pass through.

entries.name: voice.AutoGain
entries.help: Level a quiet or a loud microphone toward one speaking level

entries.name: voice.AutoGainMaxDb
entries.help: The most automatic gain will add, in dB

entries.name: voice.AutoGainTarget
entries.help: Speaking level automatic gain aims for, as a fraction of full scale

entries.name: voice.BytesPerSecond
entries.help: Hard per-client outgoing voice bandwidth cap in bytes/second; frames over budget are dropped

entries.name: voice.Codec
entries.help: Voice codec: auto (Opus where its binaries are vendored, otherwise ADPCM), opus, or adpcm

entries.name: voice.DistanceLowPassFar
entries.help: Low-pass cutoff (Hz) a proximity voice plays through at the edge of voice.HearingRange; 20000 switches the distance low-pass off

entries.name: voice.DistanceLowPassNear
entries.help: Low-pass cutoff (Hz) a proximity voice plays through at voice.NearRange; 20000 = full band

entries.name: voice.EchoCancellation
entries.help: Cancel other players' voices coming back in through the microphone from open speakers (SpeexDSP echo canceller)

entries.name: voice.EchoTailMs
entries.help: Longest echo the canceller models, in milliseconds: speaker-to-microphone path plus device buffers

entries.name: voice.Enabled
entries.help: Master switch for proximity voice chat capture and playback

entries.name: voice.FollowPlatformMute
entries.help: Mute the microphone while the player is muted or deafened in their platform voice client (Discord), and silence incoming voice while deafened

entries.name: voice.GateCloseRms
entries.help: Capture RMS below which the noise gate closes again after its hold expires

entries.name: voice.GateHoldSeconds
entries.help: Seconds the noise gate stays open after the signal drops, so a pause mid-sentence does not clip the tail

entries.name: voice.GateOpenRms
entries.help: Capture RMS a frame must reach to open the noise gate and start transmitting

entries.name: voice.GrainMax
entries.help: How broken up a proximity voice is at the edge of hearing range, 0..1; 0 switches the grain layer off

entries.name: voice.GrainStart
entries.help: Fraction of voice.HearingRange past which a proximity voice starts to break up

entries.name: voice.HearingRange
entries.help: Distance (m) past which a proximity voice speaker is inaudible and no longer relayed

entries.name: voice.InputDevice
entries.help: Capture device id; empty means the system default
