entries.name: voice.InputDeviceList
entries.help: Capture devices the plugin found, one `id|name` row per line - published by the voice plugin, read by the settings screen

entries.name: voice.InputGain
entries.help: Linear gain applied to captured samples before the noise gate reads their energy

entries.name: voice.MimicryCapture
entries.help: Keep short in-memory fragments of consenting, unmuted players' voices for a mimic (host side; never written to disk)

entries.name: voice.MimicryConsent
entries.help: Allow the host to keep short fragments of your voice in memory for creatures that mimic players; off = nothing of your voice is kept

entries.name: voice.Mode
entries.help: Transmit mode: 0 = push-to-talk, 1 = open mic (the activation threshold is voice.GateOpenRms)

entries.name: voice.NearRange
entries.help: Distance (m) within which a proximity speaker plays at full volume before rolloff begins

entries.name: voice.NoiseSuppressDb
entries.help: How far noise suppression pushes noise down, in dB (negative)

entries.name: voice.NoiseSuppression
entries.help: Learn and subtract stationary microphone noise (fans, hum, hiss) before the gate and the encoder

entries.name: voice.Occlusion
entries.help: Muffle a speaker the local player has no line of sight to

entries.name: voice.OpusBitrate
entries.help: Target bitrate in bits/second for the Opus VBR encoder

entries.name: voice.OpusDtx
entries.help: Let Opus emit nothing at all through silence instead of a packet per 20 ms

entries.name: voice.OpusFec
entries.help: Carry a coarse copy of the previous frame in each Opus packet so one lost frame is rebuilt rather than concealed. Only while voice.OpusRedundancyMs is 0: deep redundancy replaces it

entries.name: voice.OpusRedundancyMs
entries.help: Milliseconds of past speech carried as deep redundancy (Opus DRED) in every packet, so a burst of loss is rebuilt instead of concealed. 0 turns it off and inband FEC back on

entries.name: voice.OutputVolume
entries.help: Master playback volume for every incoming voice, on top of the Voice bus

entries.name: voice.RadioAINoise
entries.help: Loudness of the noise AI hears from a radio playing a transmission (host only); 0 = radios are silent to AI

entries.name: voice.RadioBandPass
entries.help: Play radio transmissions through the 300-3400 Hz telephone band instead of full range

entries.name: voice.RadioHeight
entries.help: Height (m) above a pawn's origin its radio hangs at, where incoming transmissions play from

entries.name: voice.RadioSpeakerRange
entries.help: Distance (m) out to which another player's radio is heard playing a transmission; your own radio is always heard

entries.name: voice.RadioVolume
entries.help: Playback volume of radio transmissions, on top of the voice volume

entries.name: voice.Rolloff
entries.help: Proximity attenuation curve exponent: 1 = linear, higher falls off faster near the edge of hearing range

entries.name: weapon.DecalPoolCapacity
entries.help: Maximum live runtime-spawned impact decals; the oldest is recycled past this

entries.name: weapon.ServerRateSlack
entries.help: Fraction of the fire interval the server tolerates between client fire requests before rejecting

entries.name: wolang.DebugPort
entries.help: TCP port on 127.0.0.1 a Wolang vm opens for the debugger (VS Code's Wolang extension, `attach`) in builds with the editor. 0 = any free port, -1 = no debugger. A second vm in the same process takes a free port; each logs its own.

entries.name: world.Persistence
entries.help: World-state journal: capture destroyed/modified/runtime-spawned persistent entities across sector streaming and saves (0 = off)

entries.name: wp.CollisionProxy
entries.help: World-partition collision proxies: keep a coarse static collider for every streamed-out sector so long traces still hit (1 = on, 0 = off).

entries.name: wp.CollisionProxy.MaxResident
entries.help: How many streamed-out sectors keep a collision proxy at once; the oldest is dropped past this.

entries.name: wp.CollisionProxy.MaxTriangles
entries.help: Triangle budget of one sector's collision proxy; geometry over it is simplified, then boxed.

entries.name: wp.HLOD
entries.help: World-partition HLOD: draw a low-poly proxy mesh for streamed-out sectors (1 = on, 0 = off).

entries.name: wp.HLOD.Atlas
entries.help: Draw an HLOD proxy with its baked albedo/normal atlas when the cook gave it one (1 = on, 0 = per-object vertex colours only). Read when a sector's proxy is first drawn.

entries.name: wp.HLOD.AtlasSize
entries.help: Texel edge of the albedo/normal atlas baked into every HLOD proxy at cook (rounded up to a power of two, 16-2048; 0 = no atlas, the proxy keeps per-object vertex colours only).

entries.name: wp.HLOD.FarRadius
entries.help: Maximum distance in metres at which a streamed-out sector still draws its HLOD proxy; beyond this nothing is drawn.

entries.name: wp.HLOD.ResidentDistance
entries.help: Distance in metres past which a RESIDENT sector draws its HLOD proxy in place of its live entities (their meshes stop submitting; gameplay, physics and streaming are untouched). 0 = resident sectors always draw their entities.

entries.name: wp.RebaseDistance
entries.help: Rebase the world origin when the main camera drifts this far from it (0 = off)

entries.name: wp.RebaseGrid
entries.help: Origin shifts snap to this grid so rebased coordinates stay round
